wvwellheader.label: Well Header
wvwellheader.help: The well header information describes the well in general. The data includes ID numbers, surface location info, elevations, well license and significant dates. Bottom hole location(s) are tracked in <wvWellbore>.

dttmabandon.label: Abandon Date
dttmabandon.help: Date when the well was abandoned. Note that you track individual perf abandonment (<wvPerforationStatus>), zone abandonment (<wvZoneStatus>) and wellbore abandonment (<wvWellboreStatus>).

dttmfirstprod.label: On Production Date
dttmfirstprod.help: Date when the well first started to produce.

dttmrr.label: Rig Release Date
dttmrr.help: Original rig release for the well. Note that you can track rig releases in the <wvJobRig.DtTmEnd> to handle multi rig scenarios.

dttmspud.label: Spud Date
dttmspud.help: Original spud date for the well. Note that there is also a <wvJob.DtTmSpud> which allows you to track by job for spud for re-entry, etc.

elvorigkb.label: Original KB Elevation
elvorigkb.help: Original KB Elevation. All depths stored in the database relative to this elevation.

hih2s.label: High H2S?
hih2s.help: Does the well have a high H2S content?

hisitp.label: High SITP?
hisitp.help: Does the well have a high shut-in tubing pressure?

idrecelvhistory.label: Other Elv Link
idrecelvhistory.help: Foreign link to the <wvElevationHistory> table. Use this link to assign the default Other Elevation.

kbtocascalc.label: KB-Casing Flange Distance
kbtocascalc.help: KB elevation minus the casing flange elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.elvorigkb>-<wvwellheader.ElvCasFlange>.

kbtogrdcalc.label: KB-Ground Distance
kbtogrdcalc.help: KB elevation minus the ground elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.elvorigkb> - <wvwellheader.elvground>.

kbtomudcalc.label: KB-Mud Line Distance
kbtomudcalc.help: KB elevation minus the mud line elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.elvorigkb> - <wvwellheader.elvmudline>.

kbtoothercalc.label: KB-Other Distance
kbtoothercalc.help: KB elevation minus the Other elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.elvorigkb> - <wvwellheader.elvOther>.

kbtotubcalc.label: KB-Tubing Head Distance
kbtotubcalc.help: KB elevation minus the tubing head elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.elvorigkb> - <wvwellheader.elvtubhead>.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.help: Degrees - minutes - seconds North of equator. Format either 35° 20' 44.4552" N or 35.345682 where North is positive.

latlongdatum.label: Lat/Long Datum
latlongdatum.help: The datum that the latitude and longitude are measured on.

legalsurveyloc.label: Surface Legal Location
legalsurveyloc.help: Enter the surface location of the well.

legalsurveytyp.label: Legal Survey Type
legalsurveytyp.help: Carter, Congressional, DLS, etc. Define this field in order to access location tables.

locationnote.label: Legal Survey Note
locationnote.help: Additional notes relating to the legal survey data or measurement.

locationref.label: Location Reference
locationref.help: Reference to the point of origin used in measuring the survey footage calls to the well location.

locationsensitive.label: Location Sensitive?
locationsensitive.help: Is the location sensitive? Ex. Close proximity to a residence.

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.help: Degrees - minutes - seconds east of prime meridian. Format either 11° 14' 11.8752" E or 11.236632 where East is positive.

operated.label: Operated?
operated.help: Is this well operated? If the flag is null, then this is a non-operated well.

othertocascalc.label: Other-Casing Flange Distance
othertocascalc.help: Other elevation minus the casing flange elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.IDRecElvHistory>-<wvwellheader.ElvCasFlange>.

othertogrdcalc.label: Other-Ground Distance
othertogrdcalc.help: Other elevation minus the ground elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.IDRecElvHistory> - <wvwellheader.elvground>.

othertomudcalc.label: Other-Mud Line Distance
othertomudcalc.help: Other elevation minus the mud line elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.IDRecElvHistory> - <wvwellheader.elvmudline>.

othertotubcalc.label: Other-Tubing Head Distance
othertotubcalc.help: Other elevation minus the tubing head elevation. EQN: <wvwellheader.IDRecElvHistory> - <wvwellheader.elvtubhead>.

pbtdallcalc.label: PBTD (All)
pbtdallcalc.help: Most recent PBTD by wellbore. <wvWellborePBTD.depth> concatenated with <wvWellbore.Des> if there is more than one wellbore.

problemflag.label: Problem with the Well?
problemflag.help: Is there a current problem that needs addressing on this well?

slot.label: Slot / Conductor
slot.help: The slot or conductor name or number

tdallcalc.label: Total Depth (All)
tdallcalc.help: Deepest depth entered In the<wvWellboreSize> table concatenated with <wvWellbore.Des> if there is more than one wellbore.

tdcalc.label: Total Depth
tdcalc.help: Deepest depth entered In the<wvWellboreSize> table. If more than one wellbore exists, the deepest of them will be listed. EQN: <wvwellboresize.depthbtmactual>.

tdtvdallcalc.label: Total Depth All (TVD)
tdtvdallcalc.help: TVD of the deepest depth entered In the<wvWellboreSize> table concatenated with <wvWellbore.Des> if there is more than one wellbore.

townstateprov.label: Nearest Town State/Prov
townstateprov.help: State / Province in which the nearest town is located.

waterdepth.label: Water Depth
waterdepth.help: Water or ground water depth. Primarily used for onshore wells.

wellida.label: API/UWI
wellida.help: API number or Unique Well Identifier

welllicenseno.label: License #
welllicenseno.help: License or permit number for the well

wvwellattributes.label: Well Attribute
wvwellattributes.help: Additional attributes to describe the well. Conceptually this is an extension table to the <wvWellheader>. Use the <wvWellAttributes.Typ> to define the type of attribute and <wvWellAttributes.AttribValue> to track the value.

wvelevationhistory.label: Elevation History
wvelevationhistory.help: History of other reference elevations. Ex. KB Elv from a second rig, service rig, etc. Assign the 'active' elevation with <wvWellHeader.IDRecElvHistory>. This is the value that the system will use if you select 'Well Specific Other Elevation (OTH)' for the reference datum.

elvotherlabel.label: Other Elevation Label
elvotherlabel.help: Short type of the other elevation for display in the units if the working elevation is selected. Most often will be the reference elevation of a new rig.

idreclastrigcalc.label: <capl>
idreclastrigcalc.help: EQN: <wvJobRig.DtTmStart> < <wvElevationHistory.ElvDtTmEnd> and <wvJobRig.DtTmEnd> > = <wvElevationHistory.ElvDtTmStart>. If there are multiple rigs, then choose the last one (by date).

wvoperatorhistory.label: Operator History
wvoperatorhistory.help: History of operators of this well.

changetyp1.label: Change Type
changetyp1.help: Example. Acquisition, operator name change, etc.

source.label: Source
source.help: Source of information. Ex. government agency, etc.

wvwellalias.label: Well Alias History
wvwellalias.help: History or Well ID changes. Example. <wvWellheader.wellname>, <wvwellheader.wellIDA>. Table is also designed to store an unlimited number of alias values for the <wvWellheader>.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Start date of this ID value.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: End date of this ID value.

source.label: Source
source.help: Source of information. Ex. government agency, etc.

wvnote.label: General Note
wvnote.help: General notes that do not fall under another category in the data structure.

wvdepthannotation.label: Schematic Annotation
wvdepthannotation.help: Annotations on the schematic at a specified depth on a given date.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Earliest date the annotation will appear on the schematic

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Latest date the annotation will appear on the schematic

idrecwellbore.label: <capl>
idrecwellbore.help: Which wellbore this annotation should appear on

depth.label: Depth
depth.help: Depth the annotation will appear on the schematic

depthtvdcalc.label: Depth (TVD)
depthtvdcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvDepthAnnotation.Depth> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

annotation.label: Annotation
annotation.help: The text that will be displayed on the schematic.

idrecjob.label: <capl>
idrecjob.help: Reference to the job during which this event was performed or is proposed to be performed

proposed.label: Proposed?
proposed.help: Is this item or event proposed? If proposed it will only show up on the Proposed Schematic.

wvresponsibleteam.label: Responsible Team
wvresponsibleteam.help: Names, roles and contact information for personnel involved with the well. A start and end date allow you to track changes to the contact over time. Note that this list is independent from <wvJobContact>, which is relevant to the <wvjob> only.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Start of the job or proposed start of the job

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Start of the job or proposed start of the job

rptdist.label: Report Distribution
rptdist.help: Report distribution requirements for this contact

title.label: Title
title.help: Job title or area of responsibility if title is not descriptive enough. ex.: Drilling Manager, Tool Push, Coring Operations Manager.

wvextreport.label: External Reporting
wvextreport.help: External reporting allows you to track regulatory and external reporting requirements that do not reside in other parts of the data model.

wvextreportdetail.label: External Reporting Detail
wvextreportdetail.help: Define the status and report date.

wvextreportdetailchecklist.label: External Reporting Detail List
wvextreportdetailchecklist.help: Define the detailed elements for the regulatory or external submission.

idrecitem.label: Link
idrecitem.help: Record this task is associated to

wvtask.label: Task
wvtask.help: Task type, description and recurring pattern. This table groups the <wvTaskDetail> specifics.

typ1.label: Type
typ1.help: Primary type of the activity request.

typ2.label: Sub Type
typ2.help: Secondary type of the activity request.

wvtaskdetail.label: Task Detail
wvtaskdetail.help: Tasks details including priority, status, request / assign / complete dates.

actioncom.label: Action Details
actioncom.help: Comment on actions to task request

assigntodept.label: Department Assigned To
assigntodept.help: Department the request is assigned to.

assigntoemail.label: Assign To Email
assigntoemail.help: Email address of the person assigned the task.

assigntoname.label: Name Assigned To
assigntoname.help: Name of the person assigned the task.

des.label: Description
des.help: Description or short name of the task

dttmactionrqd.label: Action Required Date
dttmactionrqd.help: Date that the action is required to be completed

dttmassigned.label: Assigned Date
dttmassigned.help: Date (optionally including time) that the task was assigned.

dttmcomplete.label: Completed Date
dttmcomplete.help: Date (optionally including time) that the task was completed.

idrecitem.label: Link
idrecitem.help: Record this task is associated to

requestbyemail.label: Requestor Email
requestbyemail.help: Email address of the person requesting the activity.

requestbyname.label: Requestor Name
requestbyname.help: Name of the person requesting the activity

typ1.label: Type
typ1.help: Primary type of the activity request.

typ2.label: Sub Type
typ2.help: Secondary type of the activity request.

wvinspect.label: Inspection
wvinspect.help: General inspection details. Type, frequency, and recurrence pattern.

dttmlastinspectioncalc.label: Last Inspection Date
dttmlastinspectioncalc.help: <wvInspectDetail.DtTm> of the most recent record by date.

dttmnextinspectioncalc.label: Next Inspection Date
dttmnextinspectioncalc.help: <wvInspectDetail.DtTm> of the most recent record by date + <wvInspect.RecurFrequency>.

idrecitem.label: Link
idrecitem.help: Link this inspection to relevant data.

commingled.label: Commingled
commingled.help: Does this represent a commingled zone. Enter related zones in child table.

currentstatuscalc.label: Current Status
currentstatuscalc.help: Most recent status by date. EQN: <wvzonestatus.status>.

depthtvdbtmcalc.label: Depth Btm (TVD)
depthtvdbtmcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvZone.DepthBtm> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdrefcalc.label: Depth Ref (TVD)
depthtvdrefcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvZone.DepthRef> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdtopcalc.label: Top Depth(TVD)
depthtvdtopcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvZone.DepthTop> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

dttmstatuscalc.label: Current Status Date
dttmstatuscalc.help: Date and time of most recent status. EQN: <wvzonestatus.dttm>.

formationcalc.label: Formation
formationcalc.help: Calculation of the formation(s). EQN: <wvZone.DepthTop> < <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalBtm> and <wvZone.DepthBtm> >= <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalTop>. If formation Final depths are null, then use Drilling depths.

formationlayercalc.label: Layer
formationlayercalc.help: Calculation of the formation layer(s). EQN: <wvZone.DepthTop> < <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalBtm> and <wvZone.DepthBtm> >= <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalTop>. If formation Final depths are null, then use Drilling depths.

iconname.label: Icon
iconname.help: Icon to display on the schematic.

zoneida.label: Zone API #
zoneida.help: UWI / API number. may have to be normalized out to consider changes

zonelicenseno.label: Zone License Number
zonelicenseno.help: license or permit number for the producing zone

status.label: Status
status.help: Suspended, Abandoned, Abandoned and Reentered, Potential, Standing, Junked and Abandoned, Closed, Flowing, Pumping, Gas Lift, Testing

fluiddes.label: Fluid Type
fluiddes.help: Crude oil, gas, oil, gas-water, undesignated, water, brine, waste, solvent, steam, air, synthetic crude, CO2, Polymer, Nitrogen, liquid petroleum gas, crude bitumen

typ.label: Well Type
typ.help: Reproducer, Storage, Injection, Disposal, observation, cyclical, source

idrecjob.label: <capl>
idrecjob.help: Link to job related to the current status.

wvzonelink.label: Zone Link
wvzonelink.help: Link the <wvzone> to associated equipment, wellbore, job by date. This allows you to define the flow path that is relevant to the <wvZone>.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Starting time of when this item was associated with this zone.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Ending time of when this item was associated with this zone.

wvzonecommingle.label: Commingled Zone
wvzonecommingle.help: Commingled zone history. This table allows you to link all of the zones that are commingled for a period of time.

idreczone.label: Commingled Zones
idreczone.help: link to zones that are commingled

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Starting time of when this zone was commingled

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Ending time of when this zone was commingled

wvzonealias.label: Zone Alias History
wvzonealias.help: History of <wvZone> ID changes. Example. <wvZone.Zonename>, <wvZone.ZoneIDA>. Table is also designed to store an unlimited number of alias values for the <wvZone>.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Start date of this ID value.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: End date of this ID value.

source.label: Source
source.help: Source of information. Ex. government agency, etc.

activitytyp.label: Activity Type
activitytyp.help: The type of activity that caused the movement of fluids to occur such as produce, inject, flare, sale, fuel, other.

durationdown.label: Total Downtime
durationdown.help: Sum of <wvProductionDownTime.Duration> for this production type in this zone.

durationprod.label: Total Producing Time
durationprod.help: Producing time. EQN: <wvProduction.DtTmEnd> - <wvProduction.DtTmStart> - <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationDown> for this production type in this zone.

ratiodurationprod.label: % Producing Time
ratiodurationprod.help: Percent producing time for this production type from this zone. EQN: <wvZoneProdTypCalc.DurationProd> / (<wvZoneProdTypCalc.DurationDown> + <wvZoneProdTypCalc.DurationProd>)

ratiodurationdown.label: % Downtime
ratiodurationdown.help: Percent downtime for this production type from this zone. EQN: <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationCumDown> / (<wvProduction.DtTmEnd> - <wvProduction.DtTmStart> - <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationDown>)

volumecond.label: Volume Condensate
volumecond.help: Total condensate volume produced for this production type from this zone.

volumegasother.label: Volume Other Gas
volumegasother.help: Total other gas volume produced for this production type from this zone.

volumeliquidother.label: Volume Other Liquid
volumeliquidother.help: Total other liquid volume produced for this production type from this zone.

volumeoil.label: Volume Oil
volumeoil.help: Total oil volume produced for this production type from this zone.

volumeresgas.label: Volume Reservoir Gas
volumeresgas.help: Total reservoir gas volume produced for this production type from this zone.

volumewater.label: Volume Water
volumewater.help: Total water volume produced for this production type from this zone.

durationprod.label: Producing Time
durationprod.help: Producing time. EQN: <wvProduction.DtTmEnd> - <wvProduction.DtTmStart> - <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationDown> for this production period.

durationdown.label: Downtime
durationdown.help: Sum of <wvProductionDownTime.Duration> for this production period.

durationprodcum.label: Cumulative Producing Time
durationprodcum.help: Cumulative producing time. EQN: sum of <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationProduce> for this and previous production periods.

durationdowncum.label: Cumulative Downtime
durationdowncum.help: Sum of <wvProductionDownTime.Duration> for this and all previous production periods.

ratiodurationcumdown.label: Cumulative % Downtime
ratiodurationcumdown.help: Percent downtime up to and including this production time period. EQN: <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationCumDown> / (<wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationCumDown> + <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationProduceCum>)

ratiodurationcumprod.label: Cumulative % Producing Time
ratiodurationcumprod.help: Percent downtime up to and including this production time period. EQN: <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationCumProduce> / (<wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationCumDown> + <wvZoneProdTypDataCalc.DurationProduceCum>)

wvzoneformationcalc.label: Associated Formations
wvzoneformationcalc.help: Calculation of the formation(s). EQN: <wvZone.DepthTop> < <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalBtm> and <wvZone.DepthBtm> >= <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalTop>. If formation Final depths are null, then use Drilling depths.

idrecformation.label: Formation
idrecformation.help: Formations associated with this Zone by depth

wvwellbore.label: Wellbore
wvwellbore.help: Description for all wellbores in this well. This includes all legs and sidetracks. WellView defines a hole as starting from either the surface for the original hole or the kick-off point for a leg or sidetrack. Link the actual survey to <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyActual> and proposed to <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyProp> for survey calculations

closedircalc.label: Closure Direction
closedircalc.help: Closure direction to the last directional survey point on the directional survey for this wellbore.

departmaxcalc.label: Max Departure
departmaxcalc.help: Maximum departure of the wellbore. EQN: max value <wvwellboredirsurveydata.departcalc>.

depthtvdfillcalc.label: Fill Depth (TVD)
depthtvdfillcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellbore.DepthFill> from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdstartcalc.label: Start Depth (TVD)
depthtvdstartcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellbore.DepthStart> from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdkickoffcalc.label: Kick Off Depth  (TVD)
depthtvdkickoffcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellbore.KickOffDepth> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

des.label: Wellbore Name
des.help: Wellbore description or name. Example: Original Hole, Sidetrack, etc.

dlsmaxcalc.label: Max DLS
dlsmaxcalc.help: Wellbore's maximum DLS value. EQN: Maximum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.DLSCalc>.

durationcalc.label: Duration
durationcalc.help: EQN: Sum of (<wvWellboreSize.DtTmEnd> - <wvWellboreSize.DtTmStart>) for all sections of the wellbore.

ewmaxcalc.label: Max EW for Wellbore
ewmaxcalc.help: Wellbore's maximum EW value calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Maximum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.ewcalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

ewmincalc.label: Min EW for Wellbore
ewmincalc.help: Wellbore's minimum EW value calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Minimum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.ewcalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

idrecjob.label: <capl>
idrecjob.help: Reference to the job during which this event was performed or is proposed to be performed

inclmaxcalc.label: Max Inclination
inclmaxcalc.help: Wellbore's maximum inclination calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Maximum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.inclination>.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.help: Coordinates of wellbore bottom hole. Degrees - minutes - seconds North of equator. Format either 35° 20' 44.4552" N or 35.345682 where North is positive.

latlongdatum.label: Lat/Long Datum
latlongdatum.help: The datum that the latitude and longitude are measured on.

legalsurveytyp.label: Legal Survey Type
legalsurveytyp.help: Carter, Congressional, DLS, etc. Define this field in order to access location tables.

locationnote.label: Legal Survey Note
locationnote.help: Additional notes relating to the legal survey data or measurement.

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.help: Coordinates of wellbore bottom hole. Degrees - minutes - seconds east of prime meridian. Format either 11° 14' 11.8752" E or 11.236632 where East is positive.

nsmaxcalc.label: Max NS for Wellbore
nsmaxcalc.help: Wellbore's maximum NS value calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Maximum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.nscalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

nsmincalc.label: Min NS for Wellbore
nsmincalc.help: Wellbore's minimum NS value calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Minimum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.nscalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

townstateprov.label: Nearest Town State/Prov
townstateprov.help: State / Province in which the nearest town is located.

tvdmaxcalc.label: Max TVD
tvdmaxcalc.help: Wellbore's maximum TVD value calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Maximum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.tvdcalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

tvdmincalc.label: Min TVD
tvdmincalc.help: Wellbore's minimum TVD value calculated from the directional survey data. EQN: Minimum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.tvdcalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

vsdir.label: Vertical Section Direction
vsdir.help: Vertical section direction specifies the plane that calculations and graphs are displayed. Leaving this blank assumes that the VS direction is to the last survey point

vsoriginew.label: Vertical Section East-West Origin
vsoriginew.help: East-West origin of the vertical section displacement calculation. If zero assumes the vertical section originates at the slot/surface. East is positive, West negative. This value is used in the VS calcs.

vsoriginns.label: Vertical Section North-South Origin
vsoriginns.help: North-South origin of the vertical section displacement calculation. If zero assumes the vertical section originates at the slot/surface. North is positive, South negative. This value is used in the VS calcs.

vsplotmaxcalc.label: Max VS for Wellbore
vsplotmaxcalc.help: Wellbore's maximum VS value. EQN: Maximum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.vscalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

vsplotmincalc.label: Min VS for Wellbore
vsplotmincalc.help: Wellbore's minimum VS value. EQN: Minimum <wvwellboredirsurveydata.vscalc>. Used for scaling directional plots.

wellboreida.label: Wellbore API/UWI
wellboreida.help: Primarily for the 12 character API hole descriptor.

wvwellboresize.label: Wellbore Section
wvwellboresize.help: Intervals within the wellbore that are defined by changes in hole diameter. Ex. Surface, Intermediate, Production.

depthbtmactual.label: Actual Btm Depth
depthbtmactual.help: Deepest depth at this hole size

depthtopactual.label: Actual Top Depth
depthtopactual.help: Shallowest depth at this hole size

depthbtmprop.label: Proposed Btm Depth
depthbtmprop.help: Proposed bottom depth for this hole section.

depthtopprop.label: Proposed Top Depth
depthtopprop.help: Proposed top depth for this hole section.

depthtvdbtmactualcalc.label: Actual Btm Depth (TVD)
depthtvdbtmactualcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellboreSize.DepthBtmActual> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdtopactualcalc.label: Actual Top Depth (TVD)
depthtvdtopactualcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellboreSize.DepthTopActual> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdbtmpropcalc.label: Proposed Btm Depth (TVD)
depthtvdbtmpropcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellboreSize.DepthBtmProp> in the associated wellbore, from the proposed directional survey data, <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyProp>.

depthtvdtoppropcalc.label: Proposed Top Depth (TVD)
depthtvdtoppropcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvWellboreSize.DepthTopProp> in the associated wellbore, from the proposed directional survey data, <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyProp>.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Date that drilling ended for this hole section.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Date that drilling started for this hole section.

muddensitymaxcalc.label: Max Mud Density
muddensitymaxcalc.help: Maximum mud density for this wellbore section. EQN: Max <wvJobReportMudChk.Density> for associated wellbore, where <wvJobReportMudChk.depth> between <wvWellboreSize.DepthBtmActual> and <wvWellboreSize.DepthTopActual>.

wvwellboresummarycalc.label: Wellbore Section Summary
wvwellboresummarycalc.help: Summarized wellbore sections. This table is populated from <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam> if there are no <wvWellboreSize> records, else the source is <wvWellboreSize> table.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Latest date from <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DtTmEnd> or <wvWellboreSize.DtTmEnd>.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Earliest date from <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DtTmStart> or <wvWellboreSize.DttmStart>.

idrecjobdrillstring.label: <capl>

dttmstartplan.help: Planned start date for the Job.

dttmtotaldepthcalc.label: Date TD Reached (wellbore)
dttmtotaldepthcalc.help: The greatest <wvWellboreSize.DtTmEnd> from all wellbores drilled during this job. EQN: First <wvJob.DtTmStart> < <wvwellboresize.dttmend> <= Last <wvJobReport.DtTmEnd>.

durationpersonnelotcalc.label: Personnel OT Hours
durationpersonnelotcalc.help: Total over-time hours for this job. EQN: Cum of <wvJobReportPersonnelCount.durationworkot>.

durationpersonnelregcalc.label: Personnel Regular hours
durationpersonnelregcalc.help: Total regular hours for this job. EQN: Cum of <wvJobReportPersonnelCount.durationworkreg>*<wvjobreportpersonnelcount.HeadCount> .

durationpersonneltotcalc.label: Personnel Total Hours
durationpersonneltotcalc.help: Total regular plus over-time hours this job. EQN: <wvjob.DurationPersonnelRegCalc> + <wvjob.DurationPersonnelOTCalc>

durationproblemtimecalc.label: Total Problem Hours
durationproblemtimecalc.help: Total problem hours calculated from the <wvJobIntervalProblem> table. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.durationproblemtimecalc>

durationspudtimelogcalc.label: Total Time Log Hours (Spud to TD)
durationspudtimelogcalc.help: Total time log hours after spud date. Sum of all <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> after <wvjob.dttmspud> (or if this is blank, use <wvWellheader.DtTmSpud>) and before <wvjob.dttmtotaldepthcalc>. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive'. Calc is reliant upon <wvJob.DttmEnd>.

durationspudtotdcalc.label: Spud to TD Duration
durationspudtotdcalc.help: Total time from Spud to Total Depth. The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. EQN: (<wvJob.DtTmTotalDepthCalc>) - (<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>).

durationtimelogtotalcalc.label: Total Time Log Hours
durationtimelogtotalcalc.help: Total time log hours entered for this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.durationtimelogtotalcalc>. Excludes any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

estcostnormsavecalc.label: Normalized Possible Cost Savings
estcostnormsavecalc.help: Normalized potential cost savings for job if the lesson is applied. EQN: <wvjob.estcostsavecalc> * <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

estcostsavecalc.label: Possible Cost Savings
estcostsavecalc.help: Potential cost savings for job if the lesson is applied. EQN: Cum of <wvjobintervallesson.estcostsaving>.

estproblemcostcalc.label: Estimated Problem Cost
estproblemcostcalc.help: Estimated cost of all interval problems in this job. EQN: Cum of <wvjobintervalproblem.EstCostOverride>.

estproblemcostnormcalc.label: Normalized Estimated Problem Cost
estproblemcostnormcalc.help: Normalized estimated cost of all interval problems in this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjob.estproblemcostcalc> * <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

estproblemtimecalc.label: Estimated Problem Time
estproblemtimecalc.help: Estimated time lost due to interval problems in this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobintervalproblem.estlosttime>.

esttimesavecalc.label: Possible Time Savings
esttimesavecalc.help: Potential time savings for job if the lesson is applied. EQN: Cum of <wvjobintervallesson.esttimesaving>.

finalinvoicetotalcalc.label: Total Final Invoice
finalinvoicetotalcalc.help: Total final invoiced costs for the job. EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFE.FinalInvoiceTotalCalc>.

finalinvoicetotalnormcalc.label: Normalized Total Final Invoice
finalinvoicetotalnormcalc.help: Normalized total final invoiced costs for the job. EQN: <wvjob.FinalInvoiceTotalCalc> * <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

hazardidnorptcalc.label: Number of Hazard IDs
hazardidnorptcalc.help: Total number of reports submitted for this job EQN: Last <wvJobReport.HazardIDNoRptCumCalc>.

idrectub.label: Primary <capl>  Affected
idrectub.help: Identify the primary tubing string that was affected by this job

idrecwellbore.label: Primary <capl> Affected
idrecwellbore.help: Identify the primary wellbore that was affected by this job.

idrecwellborecalc.label: <capl>
idrecwellborecalc.help: Last wellbore related to the job. EQN: last <wvJobReport.IDRecWellboreCalc>

jobsupplycostcalc.label: Total Job Supply Field Est
jobsupplycostcalc.help: Total JobSupply additive costs for the job. EQN: Cum of <wvJobSupplyAmt.costcalc>.

jobsupplycostnormcalc.label: Normalized Total Job Supply Field Est
jobsupplycostnormcalc.help: Normalized total Job Supply costs for the job. EQN: Sum of <wvJobSupplyAmt.costcalc> * <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

jobtyp.label: Primary Job Type
jobtyp.help: Drill, pump change, workover, swab, frac, etc.

mudcostcalc.label: Total Mud Additive Field Est
mudcostcalc.help: Total mud additive costs for the job. EQN: Cum of <wvjobmudadd.costcalc>.

mudcostnormcalc.label: Normalized Total Mud Additive Field Est
mudcostnormcalc.help: Normalized total mud additive costs for the job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudadd.costcalc> * <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

muddensitymaxcalc.label: Max Mud Density
muddensitymaxcalc.help: Maximum mud density for this Job. EQN: Max <wvJobReportMudChk.Density> in this <wvJob>.

objective.label: Objective
objective.help: a brief description of the job's objective

objectivegeo.label: Geological Objective
objectivegeo.help: a brief description of the job's geological objective

percenttmrotatingcalc.label: % Rotating Time
percenttmrotatingcalc.help: Rotating hours / Total drilling hours for the job. EQN: <wvJob.TmRotatingCalc>/<wvJob.TmDrillCalc>.

percenttmslidingcalc.label: % Sliding Time
percenttmslidingcalc.help: Sliding hours / Total drilling hours for the job. EQN: <wvJob.TmSlidingCalc>/<wvJob.TmDrillCalc>.

ratetargetcond.label: Target Cond Rate
ratetargetcond.help: Target rate that this job could realize.

ratetargetgas.label: Target Gas Rate
ratetargetgas.help: Target rate that this job could realize.

ratetargetoil.label: Target Oil Rate
ratetargetoil.help: Target rate that this job could realize.

ratetargetwater.label: Target Water Rate
ratetargetwater.help: Target rate that this job could realize.

ropavgfromspudcalc.label: Avg ROP from Spud
ropavgfromspudcalc.help: Calculated average ROP. The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. Calc is reliant upon <wvJob.DttmEnd>. EQN: <wvjob.depthdrilledcalc>/(<wvjob.dttmtotaldepthcalc>-(<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>)).

ropcalc.label: Avg ROP
ropcalc.help: Calculated average ROP for the job. EQN: <wvjob.DepthDrilledCalc> / <wvjob.TmDrillCalc>.

roprotatingcalc.label: Rotating ROP
roprotatingcalc.help: Rotating depth drilled / rotating hours for job. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString><>0/(<wvJob.TmRotatingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

ropslidingcalc.label: Sliding Rop
ropslidingcalc.help: Sliding depth drilled / sliding hours for job. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString>=0/(<wvJob.TmSlidingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

ropspudtimelogcalc.label: Avg ROP from Spud Time
ropspudtimelogcalc.help: Calculated ROP based on the time log hours. The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. The equation excludes inactive time. Calc is reliant upon <wvJob.DttmEnd>. EQN: <wvjob.depthdrilledcalc>/(<wvjob.durationspudtimelogcalc>).

roptimelogcalc.label: Avg ROP from Time Log
roptimelogcalc.help: Calculated ROP based on the time log hours. EQN: <wvjob.depthdrilledcalc>/<wvJob.DurationTimeLogTotalCalc>

targetdepthtvdcalc.label: Target Depth (TVD)
targetdepthtvdcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJob.TargetDepth> in the associated wellbore, from the proposed directional survey data, <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyProp>.

targetform.label: Target Formation
targetform.help: Target formation of the job. Typically the licensed formation.

tmcirccalc.label: Circulating Hours
tmcirccalc.help: Total circulating time for this job, calculated from the drilling parameters. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.TmCirc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmdrillcalc.label: Drilling Hours
tmdrillcalc.help: Total drilling time for this job, calculated from the drilling parameters. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.TmDrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmrotatingcalc.label: Rotating Time
tmrotatingcalc.help: Total rotating time for job. EQN: Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmRotatingCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmslidingcalc.label: Sliding Time
tmslidingcalc.help: Total sliding time for job. EQN: Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmSlidingCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

totaldepthcalc.label: Total Depth Reached (wellbore)
totaldepthcalc.help: The Total Depth <wvWellboreSize.DepthBtmActual> that corresponds to <wvJob.DtTmTotalDepthCalc>.

varianceafefinalcalc.label: AFE - Final Invoice
varianceafefinalcalc.help: Variance between AFE and Final Invoiced Amount. EQN: <wvjob.AFETotalCalc>-<wvJob.FinalInvoiceTotalCalc>.

variancefieldcalc.label: AFE-Field Estimate
variancefieldcalc.help: Variance between AFE and Field Estimates. EQN: <wvJob.AFETotalcalc> - <wvjob.CostTotalCalc>.

variancefieldfinalcalc.label: Field - Final Invoice
variancefieldfinalcalc.help: Variance between Field Estimates and Final Invoiced amount. EQN: <wvjob.CostTotalCalc>-<wvJob.FinalInvoiceTotalCalc>.

variancefinalcalc.label: AFE-Final Job Cost
variancefinalcalc.help: Variance between AFE and Final Job Cost. EQN: <wvJob.AFETotalCalc> - <wvjob.CostFinalActual>.

variancenormafefinalcalc.label: Normalized AFE - Final Invoice
variancenormafefinalcalc.help: Normalized variance between AFE and Final Invoiced Costs defined in <wvJobAFEFinalInvoiceCost>. EQN: <wvJob.VarianceAFEFinalCalc>* <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

variancenormfieldcalc.label: Normalized AFE-Field Estimate
variancenormfieldcalc.help: Normalized variance between AFE and Field Estimates. EQN: <wvjob.variancefieldcalc>* <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>

variancenormfieldfinalcalc.label: Normalized Field - Final Invoice
variancenormfieldfinalcalc.help: Normalized variance between Field Estimates and Final Invoiced Amount. EQN: <wvJob.VarianceFieldFinalCalc>* <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

variancenormfinalcalc.label: Normalized AFE-Final Job Cost
variancenormfinalcalc.help: Normalized variance between AFE and Final Job Cost. EQN: <wvjob.variancefinalcalc> *<wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

wvjobdate.label: Job Date
wvjobdate.help: Additional dates (milestones) of importance to this <wvjob>. Ex. Suspend, Resume, Dry Hole, etc.

typ1.label: Type
typ1.help: Type of date. Example: Job suspended, Job resumed, Dry hole.

note.label: Note
note.help: Additional note related to this date and type.

wvjobapproval.label: Approval
wvjobapproval.help: Definition of the approval process. Ex. 'Request to drill' for a planned <wvJob>.

wvjobapprovaldeliv.label: Deliverable
wvjobapprovaldeliv.help: Deliverables for the steps of the approval process. Type, assignment details and required dates.

wvjobapprovaldelivpred.label: Predecessor
wvjobapprovaldelivpred.help: Identify dependencies on other deliverables in the approval process.

wvjobapprovaldelivname.label: Approval Name
wvjobapprovaldelivname.help: Names of approvers, reviewers, contacts in the approval process for this step.

approvetyp.label: Type
approvetyp.help: Type of approval, ex.. Geology, Drilling, Exploitation, Partner, etc.

approverole.label: Approval Role
approverole.help: Role in approval process. Ex. Approver, Owner, Reviewer.

wvjobprogramphase.label: Phase
wvjobprogramphase.help: Planned phases of the <wvjob>. This data can be used to compare plan to actual performance; days vs depth and cost, etc.

activitydurationmaxcalc.label: Activity Plan Max Cum Days
activitydurationmaxcalc.help: Sum of Max durations from Phase Activity folder. EQN: sum of <wvjobProgramPhaseActivity.DurationMax>.

activitydurationmincalc.label: Activity Plan Min Cum Days
activitydurationmincalc.help: Sum of Min durations from Phase Activity folder. EQN: sum of <wvjobProgramPhaseActivity.DurationMin>.

activitydurationmlcalc.label: Activity Plan Likely Cum Days
activitydurationmlcalc.help: Sum of Most Likely durations from Phase Activity folder. EQN: sum of <wvjobProgramPhaseActivity.DurationML>.

basefluidvoladdedcalc.label: Base Fluid Volume Added
basefluidvoladdedcalc.help: Sum of <wvjobreportmudchk.basefluidvoladded> by date, during the period <wvjobprogramphase.dttmstartactual>-<wvjobprogramphase.dttmendactual>.

bitrevscalc.label: Bit Revs
bitrevscalc.help: Sum of bit revolutions for the phase. EQN: Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.BitRevsCalc> during the phase. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

code2.label: Phase Type 2
code2.help: 2nd level phase, sub category of Code1.

code3.label: Phase Type 3
code3.help: 3rd level phase, sub category of Code2.

code4.label: Phase Type 4
code4.help: 4th level phase, sub category of Code3.

costactualcalc.label: Actual Phase Field Est
costactualcalc.help: Total field estimated costs of this phase based on prorated daily costs and custom allocated field estimates.

costactualcumcalc.label: Actual Phase Cum Field Est
costactualcumcalc.help: Cumulative field estimated costs up to the end of this phase based on prorated daily costs and custom allocated field estimates. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.costactualcalc>.

costactualcumnormcalc.label: Normalized Actual Phase Cum Field Est

costmaxcumcalc.label: Planned Max Cum Phase Cost
costmaxcumcalc.help: Cumulative estimate of maximum costs for this job up to the end of this phase. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.costmax>.

costmaxnormcalc.label: Normalized Max Phase Cost
costmaxnormcalc.help: Normalized max cost for this phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costMax>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costmaxnormcumcalc.label: Normalized Max Cum Phase Cost
costmaxnormcumcalc.help: Normalized max cum cost for this phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costmaxcumcalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costmincumcalc.label: Planned Min Cum Phase Cost
costmincumcalc.help: Cumulative estimate of minimum costs for this job up to the end of this phase. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.costmin>.

costminnormcalc.label: Normalized Min Phase Cost
costminnormcalc.help: Normalized min cost for this phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costMin>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costminnormcumcalc.label: Normalized Min Cum Phase Cost
costminnormcumcalc.help: Normalized min cum cost for this phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costmincumcalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costml.label: Planned Likely Phase Cost
costml.help: Most likely cost of the phase.

costmlcumcalc.label: Planned Likely Cum Phase Cost
costmlcumcalc.help: Cumulative estimate of most likely costs for this job up to the end of this phase. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.costml>.

costmlnormcalc.label: Normalized Planned Likely Phase Cost
costmlnormcalc.help: Normalized most likely cost for this phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costml>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costmlnormcumcalc.label: Normalized Planned Likely Cum Phase Cost
costmlnormcumcalc.help: Normalized most likely cum cost for this phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costmlcumcalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costperdepthcalc.label: Cost Per Depth Drilled
costperdepthcalc.help: Calculated $/m or $/foot for the phase. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.CostActualCalc> /<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthProgressActualCalc>. Value is null if <wvJobProgramPhase.DepthProgressActualCalc> = 0.

costperdepthnormcalc.label: Normalized Cost Per Depth Drilled
costperdepthnormcalc.help: Normalized calculated $/m or $/foot for the phase. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.CostPerDepthCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costperdepthplancalc.label: Plan Cost Per Depth
costperdepthplancalc.help: Planned $/m or $/foot for the entire phase. EQN:<wvJobProgramPhase.CostML> / <wvJobProgramPhase.DepthProgressPlanCalc>. Value is null if <wvJobProgramPhase.DepthProgressPlanCalc> = 0.

costperdepthplannormcalc.label: Normalized Plan Cost Per Depth
costperdepthplannormcalc.help: Normalized planned $/m or $/foot for the entire phase. EQN:<wvJobProgramPhase.CostPerDepthPlanCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>

costvariancecalc.label: Variance - Cost ML
costvariancecalc.help: Variance between the planned most likely cost and the actual entered daily costs. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costml>-<wvjobprogramphase.costactualcalc>.

costvariancecumcalc.label: Variance - Cum Cost ML
costvariancecumcalc.help: Cumulative variance between the planned most likely costs and the actual field estimate daily costs up to the end of this phase. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.costmlcumcalc>-<wvJobProgramPhase.costactualcumcalc>.

costvariancemaxcalc.label: Variance - Cost Max
costvariancemaxcalc.help: Variance between the planned max cost and the actual entered daily costs. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costmax>-<wvjobprogramphase.costactualcalc>.

costvariancemaxcumcalc.label: Variance - Cum Cost Max
costvariancemaxcumcalc.help: Cumulative variance between the planned maximum costs and the actual field estimate daily costs up to the end of this phase. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.costmaxcumcalc>-<wvJobProgramPhase.costactualcumcalc>.

costvariancemincalc.label: Variance - Cost Min
costvariancemincalc.help: Variance between the planned min cost and the actual entered daily costs. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.costmin>-<wvjobprogramphase.costactualcalc>.

costvariancemincumcalc.label: Variance - Cum Cost Min
costvariancemincumcalc.help: Cumulative variance between the planned minimum costs and the actual field estimate daily costs up to the end of this phase. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.costmincumcalc>-<wvJobProgramPhase.costactualcumcalc>.

daysfromspudcalc.label: Days From Spud
daysfromspudcalc.help: Number of days from spud date to the end of this record The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendcalc> - <wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>.

dayjobactualcalc.label: Actual Phase End Days from Start of Job
dayjobactualcalc.help: Number of days from the start of the job to the actual end of the phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendactual>-<wvjob.dttmstart>.

dayjobmaxplancalc.label: Planned Max Cum Days
dayjobmaxplancalc.help: Maximum planned report day that this activity will be complete. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.durationmax>.

dayjobminplancalc.label: Planned Min Cum Days
dayjobminplancalc.help: Minimum planned report day that this activity will be complete. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.durationmin>.

dayjobmlplancalc.label: Planned Likely Cum Days
dayjobmlplancalc.help: Most Likely planned report day that this activity will be complete. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.durationml>.

dayspudactualcalc.label: Actual Phase End Days from Spud
dayspudactualcalc.help: Number of days from spud date to the actual end of the phase. The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendactual>-<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>.

depthendactualcalc.label: Actual End Depth
depthendactualcalc.help: Depth calculated based on the last drilling parameter depth prior to the end of this phase. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthendplan.label: Planned End Depth
depthendplan.help: Planned ending depth for the phase.

depthprogressactualcalc.label: Actual Depth Progress
depthprogressactualcalc.help: Actual depth progress for the phase. EQN:(<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthEndActualCalc>-<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthStartActualCalc>). Value is null if (<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthEndActualCalc>-<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthStartActualCalc>)=0.

depthprogressplancalc.label: Plan Depth Progress
depthprogressplancalc.help: Planned depth progress for the phase. EQN:(<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthEndPlan>-<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthStartPlan>). Value is null if (<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthEndPlan>-<wvJobProgramPhase.DepthStartPlan>)=0.

depthstartactualcalc.label: Actual Start Depth
depthstartactualcalc.help: Depth calculated based on the last drilling parameter depth prior to the start of this phase. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthstartplan.label: Planned Start Depth
depthstartplan.help: Planned starting depth for the phase.

depthtvdendactualcalc.label: Actual End Depth (TVD)
depthtvdendactualcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJobProgramPhase.DepthEndActualCalc> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdendplancalc.label: Planned End Depth (TVD)
depthtvdendplancalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJobProgramPhase.DepthEndPlan> in the associated wellbore, from the proposed directional survey data, <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyProp>.

depthtvdstartactualcalc.label: Actual Start Depth (TVD)
depthtvdstartactualcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJobProgramPhase.DepthStartActualCalc> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdstartplancalc.label: Planned Start Depth (TVD)
depthtvdstartplancalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJobProgramPhase.depthstartplan> in the associated wellbore, from the proposed directional survey data, <wvWellbore.IDRecDirSrvyProp>.

durationtimelogcumspudcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days From Spud
durationtimelogcumspudcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours from Spud Date up to the end of this record. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current param. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1> or occur before (<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>).

dttmendactual.label: Actual End Date
dttmendactual.help: Actual end date and time for the phase. This date is required for phase calculations.

dttmendcalc.label: Derived End Date
dttmendcalc.help: Actual End Date used by Phase calculations if <wvJobProgramPhase.DtTmEndActualCalc> is null. EQN: last <wvJobReport.DtTmEnd>

dttmendplanmaxcalc.label: Planned Latest End Date
dttmendplanmaxcalc.help: Planned latest end of this phase based on planned durations and planned job start date. EQN: <wvjob.dttmstartplan>+<wvjobprogramphase.dayjobmaxplancalc>

dttmendplanmincalc.label: Planned Earliest End Date
dttmendplanmincalc.help: Planned earliest end of this phase based on planned durations and planned job start date. EQN: <wvjob.dttmstartplan>+<wvjobprogramphase.dayjobminplancalc>.

dttmendplanmlcalc.label: Planned Likely End Date
dttmendplanmlcalc.help: Planned most likely end of this phase based on planned durations and planned job start date. EQN: <wvjob.dttmstartplan>+<wvjobprogramphase.dayjobmlplancalc>.

dttmstartactual.label: Actual Start Date
dttmstartactual.help: Actual start date and time for the phase. This value is required for the phase calculations.

dttmstartplanmaxcalc.label: Planned Latest Start Date
dttmstartplanmaxcalc.help: Planned latest start of this phase based on planned durations and planned job start date. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendplanmaxcalc>-<wvjobprogramphase.durationmax>.

dttmstartplanmincalc.label: Planned Earliest Start Date
dttmstartplanmincalc.help: Planned earliest start of this phase based on planned durations and planned job start date. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendplanmincalc>-<wvjobprogramphase.durationmin>.

dttmstartplanmlcalc.label: Planned Likely Start Date
dttmstartplanmlcalc.help: Planned most likely start of this phase based on planned durations and planned job start date. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendplanmlcalc>-<wvjobprogramphase.durationml>.

durationactualcalc.label: Actual Duration
durationactualcalc.help: Actual duration of the phase. EQN: <wvjobprogramphase.dttmendactual>-<wvjobprogramphase.dttmstartactual>.

durationml.label: Planned Likely Duration
durationml.help: Most likely duration of the phase.

durationnoprobtimecumcalc.label: Cum Time Log - Problem Hours
durationnoprobtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobProgramPhase.DurationNoProbTimeCalc> up to the end of this phase.

durationproblemtimecalc.label: Problem Time Hours
durationproblemtimecalc.help: EQN: sum of <wvjobreporttimelog.DurationProblemTimeCalc> for this phase.

durationproblemtimecumcalc.label: Cum Problem Time Hours
durationproblemtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobreport.durationproblemtimecalc> up to the end of this phase.

durationtimelogtotalcalc.label: Time Log Total Hours
durationtimelogtotalcalc.help: Total time log hours for this phase. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.durationtimelogtotalcalc> between <wvJobProgramPhase.DtTmEndActual> - <wvJobProgramPhase.DtTmStartActual>. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

durationtimelogtotcumcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days
durationtimelogtotcumcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours up to the end of the phase. EQN: Cum of <wvjobprogramphase.durationtimelogtotalcalc> up to and including the current phase. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

durationvariancecalc.label: Ahead of Plan for Phase
durationvariancecalc.help: Variance between the most likely planned duration and the actual duration. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.durationml>-<wvJobProgramPhase.durationactualcalc>.

durationvariancecumcalc.label: Ahead of Plan for Job

For cost records that do not have <IDRecAFECustom> populated, allocate them across AFEs. For example: 2 AFEs, therefore 50% field cost to each AFE.

exclude.label: Exclude From Cost Calcs?
exclude.help: Select this flag if you want to remove this AFE from all cost related calcs. This would apply if the AFE was a preliminary or for reference only.

finalinvoicetotalcalc.label: Total Final Invoice

finalinvoicetotalnormcalc.help: Normalized total final invoiced costs. EQN: <wvjobAFE.FinalInvoiceTotalCalc>*<wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

variancenormfieldfinalcalc.label: Normalized Field - Final Invoice
variancenormfieldfinalcalc.help: Normalized variance between Field Estimates and Final Invoiced Amount. EQN: <wvJobAFE.VarianceFieldFinalCalc>* <wvjob.currencyexchangerate>.

costfinalinvoice.label: Final Invoice
costfinalinvoice.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFEFinalInvoiceCost.Amount> by Des, Code1, etc.

title.help: Job title or area of responsibility if title is not descriptive enough. ex.: Drilling Manager, Tool Push, Coring Operations Manager.

anchortyp.help: Type of anchor used on this rig

note.help: Additional note related to this date and type.

wvjobrigpumpop.help: Operational pump details. Liner size, max pressure, volume per stroke by date/time.

tmcirccalc.help: Total circulating time for this mud pump. Circulating time is tracked in <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmCirc>. <wvJobRigPumpOp.DttmEnd> and <wvJobRigPumpOp.DttmStart> must be populated, as they are compared to <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DttmStart. and <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DttmEnd. to determine the number of hours. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmdrillcalc.label: Drilling Time
tmdrillcalc.help: Total drilling time for this mud pump. Drilling time is tracked in <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmDrill>. <wvJobRigPumpOp.DttmEnd> and <wvJobRigPumpOp.DttmStart> must be populated, as they are compared to <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DttmStart. and <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DttmEnd. to determine the number of hours. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

volperstroke.label: Volume Per Stroke Override
volperstroke.help: Manually entered volume/stroke, it overrides the <wvjobrigpumpop.volperstrokecalc>.

volperstrokecalc.label: Optimum Vol Per Stroke
volperstrokecalc.help: Volume per stroke calculated based on the pump type, rod diameter, stroke length and liner size. Efficiency is assumed to be 100%. See admin guide for details.

wvjobrigpumpchk.help: Slow speed and strokes by date/time and depth. A theoretical flow rate is calculated based on pump parameters. (Note that the actual pump flowrate is tracked with the other drilling parameters in <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.LiquidInjRate>).

depth.help: Depth of the bottom of the circulating string during the test

flowratecalc.help: EQN:<wvJobRigPumpOp.VolPerStrokeCalc>*<wvJobRigPumpChk.SPM>*<wvJobRigPumpChk.VolEfficiency>. Uses the last <wvJobRigPumpOp.DttmStart> <= <wvJobRigPumpChk.DtTm>. All fields in EQN must be populated to perform calculation.

wvjobrigsolidscentcycchk.help: Centrifuge/Cyclone checks. Density, rates, hours, etc.

note.help: Other note about the shaker screen

wvjobrigsolidsshakerchk.label: Shaker Check
wvjobrigsolidsshakerchk.help: Overflow and Underflow density and rate details by date/time.

dttmstart.help: Date of installation of the BOP

wvjobrigbopcomp.help: BOP component details including type, size, make, model and ratings.

weightmaxhangoff.help: Maximum allowable hangoff weight supported by this BOP.

wvjobrigtank.label: Tank

bitwearoutcalc.label: IADC Bit Dull Out
bitwearoutcalc.help: Final bit wear codes for this bit on its last drill string run on this job. EQN: <wvjobdrillstring.bitwearcalc>.

depthdrilledjobcalc.label: Depth Drilled This Job
depthdrilledjobcalc.help: Total depth drilled with this bit for this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend> - <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthinnoexcludecalc.label: Depth In (no drill params excluded)

dttmoutnoexcludecalc.label: Date Out (no drill params excluded)

liquidinjratemincalc.label: Min Flow Rate
liquidinjratemincalc.help: Minimum liquid injection rate for all runs of this bit from the drilling parameters. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.liquidinjrate>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

percenttmrotatingcalc.label: % Rotating Time
percenttmrotatingcalc.help: Rotating hours / Total drilling hours for the bit. EQN: <wvJobDrillBit.TmRotatingCalc>/<wvJobDrillBit.TmDrilledJobCalc>.

percenttmslidingcalc.label: % Sliding Time
percenttmslidingcalc.help: Sliding hours / Total drilling hours for the bit. EQN: <wvJobDrillBit.TmSlidingCalc>/<wvJobDrillBit.TmDrilledJobCalc>.

ropjobcalc.label: Avg ROP
ropjobcalc.help: Calculated average ROP for this bit on all drill strings on this job. EQN: <wvjobdrillbit.DepthDrilledJobCalc> / <wvjobdrillbit.TmDrilledJobCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

roprotatingcalc.label: Rotating ROP
roprotatingcalc.help: Rotating depth drilled / rotating hours for bit. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString><>0)/(<wvJobDrillBit.TmRotatingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

ropslidingcalc.label: Sliding Rop
ropslidingcalc.help: Sliding depth drilled / sliding hours for bit. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>- <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString>=0)/(<wvJobDrillBit.TmSlidingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

roptotalcalc.label: Total Avg ROP
roptotalcalc.help: Calculated average ROP for this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillbit.DepthDrilledTotalCalc> / <wvjobdrillbit.TmDrilledTotalCalc>.

rpmmaxcalc.label: Max RPM
rpmmaxcalc.help: Maximum RPM (string + motor) for all runs of this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmstring> + <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmmotor>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

rpmmincalc.label: Min RPM
rpmmincalc.help: Minimum RPM (string + motor) for all runs of this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmstring> + <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmmotor>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

sppdrillmaxcalc.label: Max Stand Pipe Pressure
sppdrillmaxcalc.help: Maximum stand pipe pressure for all runs of this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.sppdrill>.The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

sppdrillmincalc.label: Min Stand Pipe Pressure
sppdrillmincalc.help: Minimum stand pipe pressure for all runs of this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.sppdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

szodpass.label: Pass through Diameter
szodpass.help: Diameter of hole the bit will pass through

tmcircjobcalc.label: Hours Circ This Job
tmcircjobcalc.help: Total circulating hours with this bit on all drill strings for this job. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmcirc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmdrilledjobcalc.label: Hours Drilled This Job
tmdrilledjobcalc.help: Total drilling hours with this bit on all drill strings for this job. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmdrilledtotalcalc.label: Total Hours Drilled by Bit
tmdrilledtotalcalc.help: Total drilling hours with this bit. EQN: <wvJobDrillBit.TmDrilledJobCalc>+<wvJobDrillBit.TmStart>.

tmrotatingcalc.label: Rotating Time
tmrotatingcalc.help: Total rotating time for the bit. EQN = sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmRotatingCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmslidingcalc.label: Sliding Time
tmslidingcalc.help: Total sliding time for the bit. EQN = sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmSlidingCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmstart.label: Starting Hours
tmstart.help: Drilling hours on bit prior to running on this job

wobmaxcalc.label: Max Weight on Bit
wobmaxcalc.help: Maximum weight on bit for all runs of this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.wob>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

wobmincalc.label: Min Weight on Bit
wobmincalc.help: Minimum weight on bit for all runs of this bit. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.wob>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

wvjobdrillstring.label: Drill String
wvjobdrillstring.help: Drill string information including dates and depths run. Includes bits, BHAs and drill pipe. The drill string links to the <wvJobDrillBit>.

bitno.label: Bit Run
bitno.help: Bit run number. Text format to allow for Bit 1a, etc.

bitrevscalc.label: Bit Revs
bitrevscalc.help: Sum of bit revolutions for the drill string. EQN: Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.BitRevsCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

bittfacalc.label: Bit Total Fluid Area (nozzles)
bittfacalc.help: Total fluid circulating area for the bit for this string. EQN: Sum of [pi*((<wvjobdrillstringbitnozzle.dia>)/2)^2]. If <wvjobdrillstring.bitTFA> is entered, it overrides this calculation.

bitwearcalc.label: IADC Bit Dull
bitwearcalc.help: Concatenated string of all bit wear codes for this run.

componentscalc.label: String Components
componentscalc.help: Concatenated list of the drillstring components starting from the bit make and model. EQN: <wvjobdrillbit.make> + <wvjobdrillstringcomp.des>.

componentsdimcalc.label: String Comp Dimension
componentsdimcalc.help: Concatenated list of the drillstring components starting from the bit make and model. EQN: <wvjobdrillbit.make> + <wvjobdrillstringcomp.des> - <wvJobDrillStringComp.SzODNom> - <wvJobDrillStringComp.Length>. Similar to <wvJobDrillString.componentscalc> but with additional attributes.

cumdepthonbitendcalc.label: Bit Depth Drilled Out
cumdepthonbitendcalc.help: Total depth drilled with this bit on selected string plus any previous runs. EQN: Sum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend> - <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

cumdepthonbitstartcalc.label: Bit Depth Drilled In
cumdepthonbitstartcalc.help: Total depth drilled with this bit prior to running on this string. EQN: Sum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend> - <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

cumtmonbitendcalc.label: Bit Hours Out
cumtmonbitendcalc.help: Total hours on selected bit on selected string plus any previous runs. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

cumtmonbitstartcalc.label: Bit Hours In
cumtmonbitstartcalc.help: Total hours on selected bit prior to running on this string. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthdrilledcalc.label: Depth Drilled
depthdrilledcalc.help: Total depth drilled with this bit on selected string. EQN: Sum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend> - <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthincalc.label: Depth In
depthincalc.help: Depth in for the bit on this string. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthinnoexcludecalc.label: Depth In (no excluded params)
depthinnoexcludecalc.help: Depth in for the bit on this string. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>. The calculation does not excludesdrilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthoutcalc.label: Depth Out
depthoutcalc.help: Depth out for the bit on this string. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthoutnoexcludecalc.label: Depth Out (no excluded params)
depthoutnoexcludecalc.help: Depth out for the bit on this string. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend>. The calculation does not exclude drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

dttmincalc.label: Date In
dttmincalc.help: Earliest date/time for the bit on this string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.dttmstart>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

dttminnoexcludecalc.label: Date In (no excluded params)
dttminnoexcludecalc.help: Earliest date/time for the bit on this string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.dttmstart>.

dttmoutcalc.label: Date Out
dttmoutcalc.help: Latest date/time for the bit on this string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.dttmend>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

dttmoutnoexcludecalc.label: Date Out (no excluded params)
dttmoutnoexcludecalc.help: Latest date/time for the bit on this string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.dttmend>.

hookloadpickupmaxcalc.label: Max Pick-Up Hook Load
hookloadpickupmaxcalc.help: Maximum pick-up hook load during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.HookLoadPickUp>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

hookloadpickupmincalc.label: Min Pick-Up Hook Load
hookloadpickupmincalc.help: Minimum pick-up hook load during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.HookLoadPickUp>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

hookloadrotatingmaxcalc.label: Max Rotating Hook Load
hookloadrotatingmaxcalc.help: Maximum rotating hook load during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.HookLoadRotating>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

hookloadrotatingmincalc.label: Min Rotating Hook Load
hookloadrotatingmincalc.help: Minimum rotating hook load during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.HookLoadRotating>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

hookloadslackoffmaxcalc.label: Max Slack-Off Hook Load
hookloadslackoffmaxcalc.help: Maximum slack off hook load during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.HookLoadSlackOff>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

hookloadslackoffmincalc.label: Min Slack-Off Hook Load
hookloadslackoffmincalc.help: Minimum slack off hook load during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.HookLoadSlackOff>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

idrecwellborecalc.label: <capl>
idrecwellborecalc.help: Last wellbore in which this BHA was run. <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.IDRecWellbore>

lengthcalc.label: String Length
lengthcalc.help: Sum of all component lengths in the string and the associated bit length. EQN: Sum of <wvjobdrillstringcomp.length> + <wvjobdrillbit.length>.

liquidinjratemaxcalc.label: Max Flow Rate
liquidinjratemaxcalc.help: Maximum liquid injection rate during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.LiquidInjRate>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

liquidinjratemincalc.label: Min Flow Rate
liquidinjratemincalc.help: Minimum liquid injection rate during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.LiquidInjRate>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

percenttmrotatingcalc.label: % Rotating Time
percenttmrotatingcalc.help: Rotating hours / Total drilling hours for the drill string. EQN: <wvJobDrillString.TmRotatingCalc>/<wvJobDrillString.TmDrilledCalc>.

percenttmslidingcalc.label: % Sliding Time
percenttmslidingcalc.help: Sliding hours / Total drilling hours for the drill string. EQN: <wvJobDrillString.TmSlidingCalc>/<wvJobDrillString.TmDrilledCalc>.

proposed.label: Proposed?
proposed.help: Is this string proposed to be run?

ropcalc.label: BHA ROP
ropcalc.help: Average ROP for the run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstring.depthdrilledcalc> / <wvjobdrillstring.tmdrilledcalc>.

roprotatingcalc.label: Rotating ROP
roprotatingcalc.help: Rotating depth drilled / rotating hours for the drill string. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString><>0)/(<wvJobDrillString.TmRotatingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

ropslidingcalc.label: Sliding Rop
ropslidingcalc.help: Sliding depth drilled / sliding hours for the drill string. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString>=0)/(<wvJobDrillString.TmSlidingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

rpmmaxcalc.label: Max RPM
rpmmaxcalc.help: Maximum RPM (string + motor) during the run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmstring> + <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmmotor>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

rpmmincalc.label: Min RPM
rpmmincalc.help: Minimum RPM (string + motor) during the run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmstring> + <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmmotor>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

sppdrillmaxcalc.label: Max Stand Pipe Pressure
sppdrillmaxcalc.help: Maximum stand pipe pressure during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.sppdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

sppdrillmincalc.label: Min Stand Pipe Pressure
sppdrillmincalc.help: Minimum stand pipe pressure during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.sppdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

stringobjective.label: BHA Objective
stringobjective.help: What is the objective of running this string?

stringresult.label: BHA Result
stringresult.help: What result was obtained with this string?

szdriftmincalc.label: Min Drift
szdriftmincalc.help: Minimum drift of any component in the string. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringcomp.szdrift>.

szodmaxcalc.label: Max Nominal OD
szodmaxcalc.help: Maximum OD of the longest component in the string. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringcomp.szodnom>.

tmcirccalc.label: Circulating Time
tmcirccalc.help: Total circulating time calculated from the drilling parameters for this string. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmcirc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

tmdrilledcalc.label: Drilling Time
tmdrilledcalc.help: Total drilling time calculated from the drilling parameters for this string. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

tmrotatingcalc.label: Rotating Time
tmrotatingcalc.help: Total rotating time for the drill string. EQN = sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmRotatingCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmslidingcalc.label: Sliding Time
tmslidingcalc.help: Total sliding time for the drill string. EQN = sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmSlidingcalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

travelequipwt.label: Travelling Equipment Weight
travelequipwt.help: Traveling equipment weight. Example: weight of blocks, crown, etc.

volumedispcalc.label: Volume Displaced (Open End)
volumedispcalc.help: The volume the string would displace if you allowed fluid to get inside the string. EQN=<wvJobDrillStringComp.VolumeDispCumCalc>.

wearbearing.label: Bit Dull-Bearing
wearbearing.help: Depending on the type of bearing, non sealed bearings are rated 0-8, sealed bearing are rated E, F, N. Fixed cutter bits are rated X

weargauge.label: Bit Dull-Gauge
weargauge.help: Under gauge in 1/16ths of an inch.

wearloc.label: Bit Dull-Tooth-Loc
wearloc.help: Allow input from library. For roller cone bits, the users have to add the cone referred to 1,2,3 or all.

weightaircalc.label: Weight of String in Air
weightaircalc.help: Weight (in air) of entire string calculated as sum of weight of string components. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringcomp.weightcumcalc>.

wobmaxcalc.label: Max Weight on Bit
wobmaxcalc.help: Maximum weight on bit during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.wob>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

wobmincalc.label: Min Weight on Bit
wobmincalc.help: Minimum weight on bit during the string run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.wob>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

wvjobdrillstringcomp.label: Drill String Component
wvjobdrillstringcomp.help: Drill String component details including OD, weight, grade. Drill string components may include drill pipe, drill collars, etc. The bit is defined in the <wvJobDrillBit>, so there is no need to define it again in this table.

conditionpull.label: Condition Pull
conditionpull.help: Enter the condition of the string when pulled.

conditionrun.label: Condition Run
conditionrun.help: Enter the condition of the string when run.

dayssinceinspectcalc.label: Days Since Last Inspection
dayssinceinspectcalc.help: Days from last inspection to date of strings final drilling parameter. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.dttmend> - <wvjobdrillstringcomp.dttmlastinspect>.

hoursendcalc.label: End Hours
hoursendcalc.help: Hours on equipment at end of run. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringcomp.HoursStart> + <wvjobdrillstring.tmdrilledcalc>.

hoursstart.label: Starting Hours
hoursstart.help: Hours on equipment at start of run

iconname.label: Icon
iconname.help: Icon to display on the schematic.

itemnocalc.label: Item Number
itemnocalc.help: This is a concatenated field. EQN: <wvjobdrillstring.StringNo> - component number.

jointstallycalc.label: Joints in Tally
jointstallycalc.help: Calculated number of joints from sum of run tallied joints in this component. EQN: Sum of all <wvjobdrillstringcomptally.jointrun> that are flagged.

lengthcumcalc.label: Cum Length
lengthcumcalc.help: Cumulative length from bottom of bit to top of component. EQN: <wvjobdrillbit.length> + <wvjobdrillstringcomp.length> up to and including the current component.

lengthtallycalc.label: Tally Length
lengthtallycalc.help: Calculated tally length from sum of run tallied joints. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringcomptally.length> for all records that have <wvjobdrillstringcomptally.jointrun> flagged.

linetosurf.label: Line to Surface?
linetosurf.help: Does this item have a line that extends to surface. Could include control, power or instrument lines.

usedclass.label: Class
usedclass.help: The used classification of the equipment

volumedispcumcalc.label: Cum Volume Displaced (Open End)
volumedispcumcalc.help: Cumulative volume of fluid displaced from bottom of string to top of component. EQN: Cum of <wvJobDrillStringComp.Length>*pi/4*((<wvJobDrillStringComp.SzODNom>^2)-(<wvJobDrillStringComp.SzIDNom>^2)) from bottom of string up to and including the current component.

weightcalc.label: Weight
weightcalc.help: Weight (in air) of component. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringcomp.wtperlength> * <wvjobdrillstringcomp.length> * Force of Gravity.

weightcumcalc.label: Cum Weight
weightcumcalc.help: Cumulative weight (in air) of string including selected item. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringcomp.weightcalc> for all previous components up to and including the current component.

wvjobdrillstringcompmotor.label: Mud Motor
wvjobdrillstringcompmotor.help: Mud motor details. Access this folder by selecting <wvJobDrillStringCompMotor> in <wvJobDrillStringComp.CompSubTyp>.

wvjobdrillstringcompvgs.label: Variable Gauge Stabilizers
wvjobdrillstringcompvgs.help: Actuation type, min and max size of the stabilizer. VG Stabilizer OD readings are tracked in <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam>. Access this folder by selecting <wvJobDrillStringCompVGS> in <wvJobDrillStringComp.CompSubTyp>.

wvjobdrillstringcompstatus.label: Status History
wvjobdrillstringcompstatus.help: Status of the drill string component by date. The associated icon will override the <wvJobDrillStringComp.IconName> where relevant, by date.

iconname.label: Icon Override
iconname.help: Icon to display on the schematic. This overrides the icon specified for this component in <wvJobDrillStringComp>.

wvjobdrillstringcomptally.label: Joint
wvjobdrillstringcomptally.help: Individual joints run for the selected drill string component. This tally is populated when you use the Edit Tally tool.

refno.label: Reference #
refno.help: Number automatically increases by 1 (one) on each new row. Start with last tally component in the hole.

volumedispcumcalc.label: Cum Volume Displaced
volumedispcumcalc.help: Cumulative volume of fluid displaced from bottom of string to top of component.

weightcumcalc.label: Cum Weight
weightcumcalc.help: Cumulative weight (in air) of string including selected item.

runnocalc.label: Run Number
