runnocalc.help: Sequence number unique across all components. 1,2,3,…

wvjobdrillstringsensor.label: Sensor
wvjobdrillstringsensor.help: Drill string sensor details, such as survey sensors. Track the sensor by type and the distance to the bit.

distancesensortobit.label: Distance from Sensor to Bit
distancesensortobit.help: Distance from the sensor to the bit.

wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.label: Drilling Parameter
wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.help: Operating parameters by time and depth. It is recommended that you enter at least one drilling parameter per <wvJobReport> period. Ideally a parameter is entered for every operational change of significance (ex. rotating vs sliding).

bitrevscalc.label: Bit Revs
bitrevscalc.help: Bit revolutions. EQN: <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMTotalCalc>*<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmDrill>*60minutes. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

bitrevscumcalc.label: Cum Bit Revs
bitrevscumcalc.help: Cum bit revolutions. EQN: Cum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.BitRevsCalc>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

daysfromspudcalc.label: Days From Spud
daysfromspudcalc.help: Number of days from spud date to the end of the drilling param date. The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.dttmend> - <wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>.

depthdrilledcalc.label: Interval Depth Drilled
depthdrilledcalc.help: Depth drilled for this drilling parameter interval. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend> - <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart>.

depthdrilledcumcalc.label: Cum Depth Drilled
depthdrilledcumcalc.help: Total depth drilled up to this point for this string. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthdrilledcalc> up to and including the current drilling parameter.

dttmend.label: End Date
dttmend.help: Date and time of the end of this drilling parameter.

dttmstart.label: Start Date
dttmstart.help: Date and time of the start of this drilling parameter.

durationnoprobtimecumcalc.label: Cum Time Log - Problem Time
durationnoprobtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobReport.DurationNoProbTimeCalc> up to the end of this drill param.

durationproblemtimecumcalc.label: Cum Problem Time
durationproblemtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobreport.durationproblemtimecalc> up to the end of this drill param.

durationtimelogcumspudcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days From Spud
durationtimelogcumspudcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours from Spud Date up to the end of this drill param. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current param. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1> or occur before (<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>).

durationtimelogtotcumcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days
durationtimelogtotcumcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours up to the end of the drill param EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current drill param. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

ecdendoverride.label: ECD End Override
ecdendoverride.help: Enter an ECD Override value to override the ECD calculation performed in the <wvJDSDPHydCalc> using API basic calculation.

excludefromnewhole.label: Exclude From New Hole?
excludefromnewhole.help: Should this section of hole be excluded from calculations of total hole drilled. This would be used for reaming, drilling fill, etc.

formationcalc.label: Formation
formationcalc.help: Calculation of the formation(s). EQN: <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> < <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalBtm> and <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd> >= <wvWellboreFormation.DepthFinalTop>. If formation Final depths are null, then use Drilling depths.

gasreturnrate.label: Gas Return Rate
gasreturnrate.help: Total gas volume returned to surface corrected to standard conditions.

hookloadpickup.label: Pick-Up String Weight
hookloadpickup.help: Sliding friction when pulling string, used for torque and drag calculations

hookloadslackoff.label: Slack-Off String Weight
hookloadslackoff.help: Sliding friction when lowering string, used for torque and drag calculations

liquidinjrateriser.label: Riser Boost
liquidinjrateriser.help: Liquid pumping rate from the surface pumps into the riser boost line.

liquidreturnrate.label: Liquid Return Rate
liquidreturnrate.help: Total liquid volume return at surface

reportdaycalc.label: Job Day
reportdaycalc.help: Day number to which this drill param corresponds, since the start of the job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.dttmstart> - <wvjob.dttmstart> + 1.

reportnocalc.label: Report Number
reportnocalc.help: Report number to which this drill param corresponds.

ropcalc.label: Interval ROP
ropcalc.help: Average ROP for this drilling parameter interval. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthdrilledcalc> / <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill>.

ropcumcalc.label: Total ROP
ropcumcalc.help: Average ROP up to this point for this string.

ropinst.label: ROP Instantaneous
ropinst.help: Instantaneous ROP, minutes per foot or meter.

rpmmotor.label: Motor RPM
rpmmotor.help: RPM of the downhole motor with respect to. the drillstring. EQN:RPM bit=RPMString+RPMMotor

rpmtotalcalc.label: Bit RPM
rpmtotalcalc.help: String RPM plus motor RPM for this drilling parameter interval. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmstring> + <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.rpmmotor>.

sppdrill.label: Stand Pipe Pressure
sppdrill.help: Standpipe pressure while drilling. Off bottom standpipe pressure would be less.

szodvgstab.label: VG Stabilizer OD
szodvgstab.help: OD of the variable gauge stabilizer.

tfo.label: Tool Face Orientation
tfo.help: Tool face orientation, 0-180deg right or left of hs, or azimuth

tforef.label: TFO Reference
tforef.help: Reference, Right or Left of Highside or Magnetic azimuth

tmcirc.label: Circulation Time
tmcirc.help: Circulating time in this time interval

tmcirccumcalc.label: Cum Circulating Time
tmcirccumcalc.help: Total circulating time up to this point for this string. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmcirc> up to and including the current drilling parameter.

tmdrill.label: Drilling Time
tmdrill.help: Time spent drilling in this time interval

tmdrillcumcalc.label: Cum Drilling Time
tmdrillcumcalc.help: Total drilling time up to this point for this string. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill> up to and including the current drilling parameter.

tmrotatingcalc.label: Rotating Time
tmrotatingcalc.help: Rotating time for the drilling parameter. EQN: If <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString>=0, then Calc=0. If <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString><>0, then Calc=<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmDrill>. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmslidingcalc.label: Sliding Time
tmslidingcalc.help: Sliding time for the drilling parameter. EQN: If <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString>=0, then Calc=<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmDrill>. If <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString><>0, then Calc=0. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

torquedrill.label: Drilling Torque
torquedrill.help: Rotary torque when drilling, used for torque and drag calculations

torqueoffbtm.label: Off Bottom Torque
torqueoffbtm.help: Rotary torque when off bottom, used for torque and drag calculations

torqueunits.label: Torque Units
torqueunits.help: Units that torque is measured in.

tvdendcalc.label: TVD End
tvdendcalc.help: Calculated TVD of end of interval

tvdstartcalc.label: TVD Start
tvdstartcalc.help: Calculated TVD of start of interval

typ.label: Parameter Type
typ.help: Parameter type (New drill, Re-drill, Ream, Core, Back ream, Other)

wob.label: Weight on Bit
wob.help: Weight on bit, normally calculated from hookload, string weight and SlideFrictDown.

wvjdsdphydcalc.label: Hydraulic Calculation
wvjdsdphydcalc.help: Hydraulic calculations based on the conditions at the bottom depth of the drilling parameter. Refer to Admin Guide for details.

avcasmax.label: Max Casing AV
avcasmax.help: Maximum annular velocity in the casing

avcasmin.label: Min Casing AV
avcasmin.help: Minimum annular velocity in the casing

avopenholemax.label: Max Open Hole AV
avopenholemax.help: Maximum annular velocity in the open hole

avopenholemin.label: Min Open Hole AV
avopenholemin.help: Minimum annular velocity in the open hole

avrisermax.label: Max Riser AV
avrisermax.help: Maximum annular velocity in the riser

avrisermin.label: Min Riser AV
avrisermin.help: Minimum annular velocity in the riser based on the ID of the riser

calcerror.label: Error
calcerror.help: Provides the error preventing the calculation from proceeding

densitylastmudchk.label: Mud Density
densitylastmudchk.help: Density from the last mud check entered by time from <wvjobreportmudchk.density>. This is the mud density used in the hydraulic calculations.

ecdend.label: ECD End
ecdend.help: Calculated ECD at the ending depth. EQN: Use <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ECDEndOverride>. If it is not entered, then use For Metric: <wvjobreportmudchk.density> + <wvJDSDPHydCalc.PressureDropAnn> / <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tvdendcalc> / (Gravity * 1000). For US units: <wvjobreportmudchk.density> + <wvJDSDPHydCalc.PressureDropAnn> / (0.052 * <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tvdendcalc>).

hydpwrbit.label: Bit Hydraulic Power
hydpwrbit.help: Hydraulic power generated by the pressure drop across the bit. Calculated using the liquid flow rate and the calculated bit pressure drop

hydpwrperarea.label: Bit Hydraulic Power Per Hole Area
hydpwrperarea.help: Hydraulic power per unit of hole area generated by the pressure drop across the bit. Calculated using the liquid flow rate, calculated bit pressure drop and the hole diameter.

jetvelocity.label: Bit Jet Velocity
jetvelocity.help: Bit jet velocity calculated using this drilling parameters liquid flow rate and the bit nozzle or flow area.

pressuredropann.label: Annular Pressure Drop
pressuredropann.help: Calculated annular pressure drop using this drilling parameters liquid flow rate and configuration of the BHA and wellbore and the mud properties of the last daily mud check prior to the end of this drilling parameter.

pressuredropbit.label: Bit Pressure Drop
pressuredropbit.help: Calculated bit pressure drop using this drilling parameters liquid flow rate and the bit nozzle or flow area and the mud properties of the last daily mud check prior to the end of this drilling parameter.

pressuredropbitratio.label: Percent of Pressure Drop at Bit
pressuredropbitratio.help: Percent of total standpipe pressure drop occurring at the bit.

volumebittoshoe.label: Bit to Shoe Volume
volumebittoshoe.help: Annulus volume (Hole diameter to drillstring component OD) from the bit up to the deepest casing shoe.

volumecastoptorisertop.label: Top of Casing to Top of Riser Volume
volumecastoptorisertop.help: Riser Volume, Riser ID less drill string ID defining the cross sectional area.

volumepumptobit.label: Drill String Volume
volumepumptobit.help: Volume from rig pump through surface equipment (wvJobRig.VolSurfLine) plus the total inside volume of the drill pipe to the end of the drillstring. Need to check that the calculated top of the drill pipe is at zero. If it is too high, cut it off, if too de

volumeshoetocastop.label: Shoe to Top of Casing Volume
volumeshoetocastop.help: Annulus volume (Casing component ID to drillstring component OD) from the deepest casing shoe to the top of the casing. If the deepest casing shoe does not go all the way to the top of any of the other casing strings you have to account for these change

wvjdsdpavcalc.label: Annular Velocities
wvjdsdpavcalc.help: Calculated annular velocities and bottom hole pressures. Refer to Admin Guide for details.

annularvelocity.label: Annular Velocity
annularvelocity.help: Calculated annular velocity based on the OD of the drillstring component, ID of the hole or casing component, and the flow rate defined in the drilling parameters. Assumes single phase (liquid) flow.

boundin.label: Inner Boundary
boundin.help: Drill string component that defines the inner boundary of the annulus

boundout.label: Outer Boundary
boundout.help: Casing, liner or wellbore component that defines the outer boundary of the annulus

calcerror.label: Error
calcerror.help: Provides the error preventing the calculation from proceeding

depthbtm.label: Bottom Depth
depthbtm.help: Deepest depth for this annular velocity interval.

depthtop.label: Top Depth
depthtop.help: Shallowest depth for this annular velocity interval.

flowregime.label: Flow Regime
flowregime.help: Flow regime of the fluid in this section. Assumed "Turbulent" if Reynolds No >= 2100 otherwise "Laminar".

pressuredrop.label: Section Pressure Drop
pressuredrop.help: Calculated pressure drop due to the fluid passing through this section of annulus

szboundin.label: Size Inner Boundary
szboundin.help: Bounding diameter of the drill string component that defines the inner boundary of the annulus

szboundout.label: Size Outer Boundary
szboundout.help: Bounding diameter of the casing, liner or wellbore section that defines the outer boundary of the annulus

volumeannulus.label: Annulus Volume
volumeannulus.help: Calculated volume of fluid contained in the annulus of the interval

wvjobsupply.label: Job Supply
wvjobsupply.help: Inventory of supplies for the <wvJob>. Ex. Fuel, cement. Description, type, vendor, cost, unit size, etc. Note that mud products are tracked independently in <wvJobMudAdd>.

consumedcalc.label: Total Consumed
consumedcalc.help: Total amount of this product consumed. EQN: <wvjobsupplyamt.consumedcumcalc> from the last record.

cost.label: Field Est
cost.help: Unit cost of this supply item

costcalc.label: Total Field Est
costcalc.help: The total cost of this product consumed during this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobSupplyAmt.consumedcalc>*<wvjobSupply.cost> for this product.

environmenttyp.label: Environmental Type
environmenttyp.help: Are there any environmental considerations related to this product.

inventorycalc.label: Inventory On Location
inventorycalc.help: The total inventory of this product. EQN: <wvjobsupply.receivedcalc> - <wvjobsupply.returnedcalc> - <wvjobsupply.consumedcalc>

receivedcalc.label: Total Received
receivedcalc.help: Total amount of this product received. EQN: <wvjobsupplyamt.receivedcumcalc> from the last record.

returnedcalc.label: Total Returned
returnedcalc.help: Total amount of this product returned. EQN: <wvjobsupplyamt.returnedcumcalc> from the last record.

unitlabel.label: Unit Label
unitlabel.help: Units the supply item is measured

wvjobsupplyamt.label: Job Supply Amount
wvjobsupplyamt.help: Details of the <wvjobSupply> amount received, consumed, and returned by date.

consumed.label: Consumed
consumed.help: Amount of product consumed since last entry

consumedcumcalc.label: Cum Consumed
consumedcumcalc.help: Total product supply consumed up to and including this field entry. EQN: Cum of <wvjobsupplyamt.consumed> up to and including this record.

costcalc.label: Field Est
costcalc.help: Cost of consumed amount. EQN: <wvjobSupplyAmt.consumed> * <wvjobSupply.cost> for this record.

costcumcalc.label: Cum Field Est
costcumcalc.help: Total cost of product consumed up to and including this field entry. EQN: Sum of <wvJobSupplyAmt.costcalc> up to and including this field entry.

inventorycumcalc.label: Cum On Location
inventorycumcalc.help: Final amount on location up to and including this field entry. EQN: <wvjobsupplyamt.receivedcumcalc> - <wvjobsupplyamt.returnedcumcalc> - <wvjobsupplyamt.consumedcumcalc>.

received.label: Received
received.help: Amount of product received on location since last entry

receivedcumcalc.label: Cum Received
receivedcumcalc.help: Total product supply received up to and including this field entry. EQN: Cum of <wvjobsupplyamt.received> up to and including this record.

returned.label: Returned
returned.help: Amount of product returned from location since last entry

returnedcumcalc.label: Cum Returned
returnedcumcalc.help: Total product supply returned to supplier up to and including this field entry. EQN: Cum of <wvjobsupplyamt.returned> up to and including this record.

wvjobmudadd.label: Mud Additive
wvjobmudadd.help: Mud additives (inventory) used during the <wvJob>. Description, type, vendor, cost, unit size, etc.

costcalc.label: Total Field Est
costcalc.help: The total cost of this product consumed during this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudadd.consumedcalc>*<wvjobmudadd.cost> for this product.

consumedcalc.label: Total Consumed
consumedcalc.help: The total quantity of this product consumed during this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.consumed> for this product.

inventorycalc.label: Inventory On Location
inventorycalc.help: The total inventory of this product. EQN: <wvjobmudadd.receivedcalc> - <wvjobmudadd.returnedcalc> - <wvjobmudadd.consumedcalc>.

receivedcalc.label: Total Received
receivedcalc.help: The total quantity of this product received during this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.received>

returnedcalc.label: Total Returned
returnedcalc.help: The total quantity of this product returned during this job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.returned>.

unitlabel.label: Units
unitlabel.help: Units the supply item is sold, ex.. lb sacks, kg sacks, us gal drums.

unitsz.label: Unit Size
unitsz.help: Quantity making up one sales unit. If product is sold by 10kg sack this value would be 10, the Unit Label would be "kg sacks".

wvjobmudaddamt.label: Mud Additive Amount
wvjobmudaddamt.help: Details of the <wvjobMudAdd> amount received, consumed, and returned by date.

consumed.label: Consumed
consumed.help: Amount of product consumed since last entry.

consumedcumcalc.label: Cum Consumed
consumedcumcalc.help: Total product consumed up to and including this field entry. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.consumed> for this product up to and including this entry.

costcalc.label: Daily Field Est
costcalc.help: Cost of consumed amount. EQN: <wvjobmudaddamt.consumed> * <wvjobmudadd.cost> for this record.

costcumcalc.label: Cum Field Est
costcumcalc.help: Total cost of product consumed up to and including this field entry. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.costcalc> up to and including this field entry.

inventorycumcalc.label: Inventory On Location
inventorycumcalc.help: Final amount on location up to and including this field entry. EQN: <wvjobmudaddamt.receivedcumcalc> - <wvjobmudaddamt.consumedcumcalc> - <wvjobmudaddamt.returnedcumcalc>.

receivedcumcalc.label: Cum Received
receivedcumcalc.help: Total product received up to and including this field entry. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.received> up to and including this field entry.

received.label: Received
received.help: Amount of product received on location since last entry

returned.label: Returned
returned.help: Amount of product returned from location since last entry

returnedcumcalc.label: Cum Returned
returnedcumcalc.help: Total product returned to supplier up to and including this field entry. EQN: Sum of <wvjobmudaddamt.returned> up to and including this field entry.

wvjobrentalitem.label: Recurring Cost Item
wvjobrentalitem.help: Enter a list of repeating costs such as equipment rentals to be used in daily reports. Days rate, Depth rate, Standby rate, etc can be defined. The appropriate rates are then applied on a daily basis in the <wvJobReportCostRental> folder.

poamt.label: Purchase Order Amount
poamt.help: Total amount of the purchase order.

wvjobreport.label: Daily Operation
wvjobreport.help: General information for the reporting period. Define the start and end of the reporting period, operational summary, etc. Generally the reporting period is 24 hrs.

bitrevscalc.label: Bit Revs
bitrevscalc.help: Sum of bit revolutions for the reporting period. EQN: Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.BitRevsCalc> during reporting period. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

condlease.label: Lease Condition
condlease.help: Condition of the lease during this reporting period.

condroad.label: Road Condition
condroad.help: Condition of the road during this reporting period.

contactcalc.label: Daily Contacts
contactcalc.help: Contacts during this report period. EQN: Concatenation of <wvJobContact.ContactName> + <wvJobContact.Title> + <wvJobContact.PhoneMobile>

costjobsupplyamtcalc.label: Daily Job Supply Field Est
costjobsupplyamtcalc.help: Total JobSupply additive costs during the report period. EQN: Cum of <wvJobSupplyAmt.costcalc> that occur during that report period.

costjobsupplyamtnormcalc.label: Normalized Daily Job Supply Field Est
costjobsupplyamtnormcalc.help: Normalized total JobSupply additive costs during the report period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostJobSupplyAddCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costjobsupplyamttodatecalc.label: Job Supply Field Est To Date
costjobsupplyamttodatecalc.help: Sum of costs calculated from JobSupply additives consumed for all days up to the end of the reporting period. EQN: Cum of <wvJobSupplyAmt.costcalc> for all days up to the end of the reporting period.

costjobsupplyamttodtncalc.label: Normalized Job Supply Field Est To Date
costjobsupplyamttodtncalc.labelShort: N Job Supply Field Est Cum
costjobsupplyamttodtncalc.help: Normalized sum of costs calculated from job supplies consumed for all days up to the end of the reporting period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostJobSupplyAmtToDateCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costmudaddcalc.label: Daily Mud Field Est
costmudaddcalc.help: Total mud additive costs during the report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobmudaddamt.costcalc> that occur during that report period.

costmudaddnormcalc.label: Normalized Daily Mud Field Est
costmudaddnormcalc.help: Normalized total mud additive costs during the report period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostMudAddCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costmudaddtodatecalc.label: Mud Additive Field Est To Date
costmudaddtodatecalc.help: Sum of costs calculated from mud additives consumed for all days up to the end of the reporting period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobmudaddamt.costcalc> for all days up to the end of the reporting period.

costmudaddtodatenormcalc.label: Normalized Mud Add Field Est To Date
costmudaddtodatenormcalc.help: Normalized sum of costs calculated from mud additives consumed for all days up to the end of the reporting period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostMudAddToDateCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costperdepthcalc.label: Cost Per Depth Drilled
costperdepthcalc.help: Calculated $/m or $/foot for the report period. EQN: <wvjobreport.CostTotalCalc>/ <wvjobreport.depthprogressdpcalc>.

costperdepthnormcalc.label: Normalized Cost Per Depth Drilled
costperdepthnormcalc.help: Normalized calculated $/m or $/foot for the report period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostPerDepthCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costtodatecalc.label: Cum Field Est To Date
costtodatecalc.help: Cumulative total of general and rental costs for all daily operations reports to the end of the report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreport.costtotalcalc> for all daily operations reports to the end of the report period.

costtodatenormcalc.label: Normalized Cum Field Est To Date
costtodatenormcalc.help: Normalized cumulative total of general and rental costs for all daily operations reports to the end of the report period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostToDateCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

costtotalcalc.label: Daily Field Est Total
costtotalcalc.help: Total of general and rental costs during the report period. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreportcostgen.cost> + <wvjobreportcostrental.costrentalcalc> for this report period.

costtotalnormcalc.label: Normalized Daily Field Est Total
costtotalnormcalc.help: Normalized total of general and rental costs during the report period. EQN: <wvJobReport.CostTotalCalc>*<wvJob.CurrencyExchangeRate>.

daysfromspudcalc.label: Days From Spud
daysfromspudcalc.help: Number of days from spud date to the end of the report date. The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. EQN: <wvjobreport.dttmend> - <wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>.

depthenddpcalc.label: End Depth
depthenddpcalc.help: Depth from the last drill param that ends before the end of the report period. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart> or <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend>. If there is no valid drill param for the day, then use the last valid end depth in the job. The calc excludes drill params that have <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthenddpnullcalc.label: End Depth Alt
depthenddpnullcalc.help: Aug 2008 maint release. This calc is identical to <wvJobReport.DepthEndDPCalc> but does NOT show 0 at the start of the job. i.e. calc behaviour prior to Q1 2007 maint release.

depthnetprogressdpcalc.label: Net Depth Progress
depthnetprogressdpcalc.help: Net depth of new hole drilled during this reporting period. EQN: <wvjobreport.DepthEndDPCalc> - <wvJobReport.DepthStartDPCalc>.

depthprogressdpcalc.label: Depth Progress
depthprogressdpcalc.help: Total depth of new hole drilled during this reporting period. EQN: Sum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend> - <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart> between the start and end of the report period. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthstartdpcalc.label: Start Depth
depthstartdpcalc.help: Depth from the first drilling parameter that occurred at or after the start of the report period. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart> or <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend>. If there is no valid drilling parameter for the day, then use the last valid end depth in the job. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthstartdpnullcalc.label: Start Depth Alt
depthstartdpnullcalc.help: Aug 2008 maint release. This calc is identical to <wvJobReport.DepthStartDPCalc> but does NOT show 0 at the start of the job. i.e. calc behaviour prior to Q1 2007 maint release.

depthtvdenddpcalc.label: End Depth (TVD)
depthtvdenddpcalc.help: TVD from the last drill param that ends before the end of the report period. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.TVDStartCalc> or <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.TVDEndCalc>. If there is no valid drill param for the day, then use the last valid end depth in the job. The calc excludes drill params that have <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthtvdendprojmethod.label: Projected TVD Calc Method
depthtvdendprojmethod.help: Method to be used for calculation of <wvJobReport.DepthTVDEndDPCalc>. The calc will use an actual survey value to perform an interpolation. If this is not available, it will use the method specified. Straight Line – Extrapolates to a point deeper than the last survey point using a constant inclination. Assumes that the well is a straight line from the last survey point to the extrapolated point. Continue Trend – Assumes that the wellpath continues the same build rate defined by the last two survey points to the extrapolated point.

depthtvdstartdpcalc.label: Start Depth (TVD)
depthtvdstartdpcalc.help: TVD from the first drilling parameter that occurred at or after the start of the report period. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tvddepthstart> or <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tvddepthend>. If there is no valid drilling parameter for the day, then use the last valid end depth in the job. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

dttmend.label: Report End Date
dttmend.help: Date and time of end of report period

dttmstart.label: Report Start Date
dttmstart.help: Date and time of start of report period

durationnoprobtimecumcalc.label: Cum Time Log - Problem Hours
durationnoprobtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobReport.DurationNoProbTimeCalc> up to the end of this reporting period.

durationpersonnelotcalc.label: Personnel OT Hours
durationpersonnelotcalc.help: Over-time hours this report period. EQN: <wvjobreportpersonnelcount.durationworkot> for this report period.

durationpersonnelregcalc.label: Personnel Regular Hours
durationpersonnelregcalc.help: Regular hours this report period. EQN: <wvjobreportpersonnelcount.durationworkreg>*<wvjobreportpersonnelcount.HeadCount> for this report period.

durationpersonneltotcalc.label: Personnel Total Hours
durationpersonneltotcalc.help: Regular hours plus over-time hours this report period. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.durationpersonnelregcalc> + <wvjobreport.durationpersonneltotcalc> for this report period.

durationproblemtimecalc.label: Problem Time Hours
durationproblemtimecalc.help: EQN: sum of <wvjobreporttimelog.durationproblemtimecalc> for this reporting period.

durationproblemtimecumcalc.label: Cum Problem Time Hours
durationproblemtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobreport.durationproblemtimecalc> up to the end of this reporting period.

durationsinceltinc.label: Days Since Lost Time Incident
durationsinceltinc.help: Days since the last lost time incident.

durationsincerptinc.label: Days Since Reportable Incident
durationsincerptinc.help: Days since the last reportable incident

durationtimelogcumspudcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days From Spud
durationtimelogcumspudcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours from Spud Date up to the end of the report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current report. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1> or occur before (<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>).

durationtimelogtotalcalc.label: Time Log Total Hours
durationtimelogtotalcalc.help: Total time log hours entered for this day. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> for this report period. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

durationtimelogtotcumcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days
durationtimelogtotcumcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours up to the end of the report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current report. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

durnoprobtimecumdayscalc.label: Cum Time Log - Problem
durnoprobtimecumdayscalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobReport.DurationNoProbTimeCalc> up to the end of this reporting period.

durpersonnelotcumcalc.label: Cum Personnel OT hours
durpersonnelotcumcalc.help: Cumulative OT hours up to the end of this report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreport.durationpersonnelotcalc> up to and including the current report.

durpersonnelregcumcalc.label: Cum Personnel Regular Hours
durpersonnelregcumcalc.help: Cumulative regular hours up to the end of this report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreport.durationpersonnelregcalc> up to and including the current report.

durpersonneltotcumcalc.label: Cum Personnel Total Hours
durpersonneltotcumcalc.help: Cumulative personnel total hours up to the end of the report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreport.durationpersonneltotcalc> up to and including the current report.

durproblemtimecumdayscalc.label: Cum Problem Time Days
durproblemtimecumdayscalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobreport.durationproblemtimecalc> up to the end of this reporting period.

durprojectedmljobcalc.label: Projected Job Duration
durprojectedmljobcalc.help: EQN: Previous phase <wvJobProgramPhase.DurCumActualCalc>+<wvJobReport.DurProjectedMLPhaseCalc>+(sum <wvJobProgramPhase.DurationML> for future phases).

durprojectedmlphasecalc.label: Projected Phase Duration
durprojectedmlphasecalc.help: Refer to Admin Guide for details. Calc is handled differently based on 'flat' and 'sloped' phases.

hazardidnorptcalc.label: Number of Hazard IDs
hazardidnorptcalc.help: Total number of hazard IDs submitted on this day. EQN: sum of <wvJobReportHazardID.NoRpt>.

hazardidnorptcumcalc.label: Cum Number of Hazard IDs
hazardidnorptcumcalc.help: Cum of total number of hazard IDs up to the end of this reporting period. EQN: Cum of <wvJobReport.HazardIDNoRptCalc>.

headcountcalc.label: Head Count
headcountcalc.help: Number of personnel on location this reporting period taken from the Personnel Log Folder. EQN: <wvjobreportpersonnelcount.headcount>.

idrecjobprogramphasecalc.label: Last Phase
idrecjobprogramphasecalc.help: Last phase that is active during this reporting period from <wvJobProgramPhase> table. <wvJobProgramPhase.DtTmStartActual> is the start of the phase, and if <wvJobProgramPhase.DttmEndActual> is not specified, then assume the phase lasts to the end of the reporting period.

idreclastcascalc.label: Last Casing String
idreclastcascalc.help: Foreign link to the last <wvcas> entry run prior to the end of this reporting period. Calc ignores proposed strings.

idreclastrigcalc.label: <capl>
idreclastrigcalc.help: Last Rig during this report period. EQN: Concatenation of <wvjobrig.contractor> and <wvjobrig.rigno>.

idrecnextcas.label: Next Casing String
idrecnextcas.help: Foreign link to the next <wvcas> entry run.

idrecwellborecalc.label: <capl>
idrecwellborecalc.help: Last wellbore affected during this reporting period. Looks at both the <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.idrecwellbore> and the <wvjobreporttimelog.idrecwellbore> . Note: the drilling parameters take precedence over the time log. If the <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.idrecwellbore> and the <wvjobreporttimelog.idrecwellbore> are null, and there is only 1 wellbore in the well, then use this wellbore. If the result is still null, then the calc uses <wvJob.IDRecWellbore>.

lastmuddensitycalc.label: Last Mud Check Density
lastmuddensitycalc.help: Density reported on last mud check before the end of the reporting period and after the start of the job. The calculation logic requires the <wvJobReportMudChk.DtTm> field to be populated.

mudvolumefinalcalc.label: Final Mud Volume
mudvolumefinalcalc.help: Mud volume balance. The last <wvJobReportMudChk.MudVolActiveCalc> <= <wvJobReport.dttmend>. If this reporting period does not have a mud check, then find the last mud check by date to the beginning of the job

percenttmrotatingcalc.label: % Rotating Time
percenttmrotatingcalc.help: Rotating hours / Total drilling hours for the reporting period. EQN: <wvJobReport.TmRotatingCalc>/<wvJobReport.TmDrillCalc>.

percenttmslidingcalc.label: % Sliding Time
percenttmslidingcalc.help: Sliding hours / Total drilling hours for the reporting period. EQN: <wvJobReport.TmSlidingCalc>/<wvJobReport.TmDrillCalc>.

remarks.label: Remarks
remarks.help: General remarks on the reporting period

reportdaycalc.label: Job Day
reportdaycalc.help: Day number since the start of the job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.dttmstart> - <wvjob.dttmstart> + 1.

reportnocalc.label: Report Number
reportnocalc.help: Report number, the count of the number of reports up to and including this report.

rigscalc.label: Rig (Names)
rigscalc.help: List of contractor name and rig number for all rigs reported during this report period. EQN: Concatenation of <wvjobrig.contractor> and <wvjobrig.rigno> for all records during this report period.

rigdayscalc.label: Number of Rig Days
rigdayscalc.help: EQN: <wvJobReport.DtTmEnd>-<wvJobRig.DtTmStart>. Use the rig determined in <wvJobReport.IDRecLastRigCalc>.

rigtimecumcalc.label: Cum Rig Time
rigtimecumcalc.help: Cumulative rig time for job. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreport.rigtime> up to and including the current report period.

ropcalc.label: Avg ROP
ropcalc.help: ROP for the reporting period. EQN: <wvjobreport.DepthProgressDPCalc>/<wvjobreport.TmDrillCalc>.

roprotatingcalc.label: Rotating ROP
roprotatingcalc.help: Rotating depth drilled / rotating hours for the reporting period. EQN=(Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString><>0 for the reporting period)/(<wvJobReport.TmRotatingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

ropslidingcalc.label: Sliding Rop
ropslidingcalc.help: Sliding depth drilled / sliding hours for the reporting period. EQN: (Sum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthEnd>-<wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.DepthStart> where <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.RPMString>=0 for the reporting period)/(<wvJobReport.TmSlidingCalc>). The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

statusend.label: Status at Reporting Time
statusend.help: Operational status at the end of the reporting period

summarygeo.label: Geological Ops This Report Period
summarygeo.help: Summary of activities during the reporting period

summaryops.label: Operations Summary
summaryops.help: Summary of activities during the reporting period

timeaheadmljobcalc.label: Job Days Ahead
timeaheadmljobcalc.help: Job days ahead (positive) or behind (negative). EQN: (sum <wvJobProgramPhase.DurationML> for entire job) - <wvJobReport.DurProjectedMLJobCalc>.

timeaheadmlphasecalc.label: Phase Days Ahead
timeaheadmlphasecalc.help: Days ahead (positive) or behind (negative) for last active phase during the current reporting period. EQN: <wvJobProgramPhase.DurationML>-<wvJobReport.DurProjectedMLPhaseCalc>.

timelogcode1calc.label: Time Log Code 1 Summary
timelogcode1calc.help: Concatenated list of the time log records. EQN: <wvJobReportTimeLog.Code1>'-'<wvJobReportTimeLog.Duration>. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1> or <wvjobReportTimeLog.inactive>=true.

timelogcode2calc.label: Time Log Code 2 Summary
timelogcode2calc.help: Concatenated list of the time log records. EQN: <wvJobReportTimeLog.Code2>'-'<wvJobReportTimeLog.Duration>. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code2> or <wvjobReportTimeLog.inactive>=true.

timelogcode3calc.label: Time Log Code 3 Summary
timelogcode3calc.help: Concatenated list of the time log records. EQN: <wvJobReportTimeLog.Code3>'-'<wvJobReportTimeLog.Duration>. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code3> or <wvjobReportTimeLog.inactive>=true.

timelogcode4calc.label: Time Log Code 4 Summary
timelogcode4calc.help: Concatenated list of the time log records. EQN: <wvJobReportTimeLog.Code4>'-'<wvJobReportTimeLog.Duration>. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code4> or <wvjobReportTimeLog.inactive>=true.

tmcirccalc.label: Circulating Hours
tmcirccalc.help: Total circulating time for this report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmcirc> for this report period. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

tmdrillcalc.label: Drilling Hours
tmdrillcalc.help: Total drilling time for this report period. EQN: Cum of <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.tmdrill> for this report period. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged

tmrotatingcalc.label: Rotating Time
tmrotatingcalc.help: Total rotating time for reporting period. EQN: Cum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmRotatingCalc> for this report period. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

tmslidingcalc.label: Sliding Time
tmslidingcalc.help: Total sliding time for reporting period. EQN: Cum of <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.TmSlidingCalc> for this report period. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

wvjobreporttimelog.label: Time Log
wvjobreporttimelog.help: Detailed breakdown of operations during this reporting period by code. Note: to handle gaps in the reporting period, enter a record with the appropriate duration and use the <wvJobReportTimeLog.Inactive> flag.

daysfromspudcalc.label: Days From Spud
daysfromspudcalc.help: Number of days from spud date to the end of this record The calculation uses <wvJob.dttmspud> or if this is blank, uses the <wvWellheader.DttmSpud>. EQN: <wvjobreport.dttmendcalc> - <wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>.

depthend.label: End Depth
depthend.help: Ending depth for time log activity, not used in drilling parameters.

depthenddpcalc.label: Drill Param End Depth
depthenddpcalc.help: Depth from the last drill param that ends before the end of the time log record. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart> or <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend>. If there is no valid drill param for the day, then use the last valid end depth in the job. The calc excludes drill params that have <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthstart.label: Start Depth
depthstart.help: Starting depth for time log activity, not used in drilling parameters.

depthstartdpcalc.label: Drill Param Start Depth
depthstartdpcalc.help: Depth from the first drilling parameter that occurred at or after the start of the time log period. EQN: <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthstart> or <wvjobdrillstringdrillparam.depthend>. If there is no valid drilling parameter for the day, then use the last valid end depth in the job. The calculation excludes drilling parameters that have the <wvJobDrillStringDrillParam.ExcludeFromNewHole> flagged.

depthtvdendcalc.label: End Depth (TVD)
depthtvdendcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJobReportTimeLog.DepthEnd> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdstartcalc.label: Start Depth (TVD)
depthtvdstartcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvJobReportTimeLog.DepthStart> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

dttmendcalc.label: End Date
dttmendcalc.help: End time of this time log entry. EQN: <wvjobreporttimelog.dttmstartcalc> + <wvjobreporttimelog.duration>.

dttmstartcalc.label: Start Date
dttmstartcalc.help: Start date and time of this time log entry. EQN: <wvjobreport.dttmstart> + <wvjobreporttimelog.sumofdurationcalc> from previous record.

durationnoprobtimecumcalc.label: Cum Time Log - Problem
durationnoprobtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobReportTimeLog.DurationNoProbTimeCalc> up to the end of this record.

durationproblemtimecalc.label: Problem Time
durationproblemtimecalc.help: Calculated net number of hours of problem time that occur during this time interval from <wvjobintervalproblem>. If there are multiple overlapping problems, only count the hours once. If <wvjobintervalproblem.dttmend> is not specified, then assume the problem lasts to the end of the reporting period.

durationproblemtimecumcalc.label: Cum Problem Time
durationproblemtimecumcalc.help: EQN: cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.durationproblemtimecalc> up to the end of this record.

durationtimelogcumspudcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days From Spud
durationtimelogcumspudcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours from Spud Date up to the end of this record. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current param. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1> or occur before (<wvjob.dttmspud> or <wvwellheader.dttmspud>).

durationtimelogtotcumcalc.label: Cum Time Log Days
durationtimelogtotcumcalc.help: Cumulative time log hours up to the end of the record EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> up to and including the current record. Exclude any time log entries that have the word 'inactive' in <wvjobreporttimelog.code1>.

idrecjobprogramphasecalc.label: Phase
idrecjobprogramphasecalc.help: Last phase that is active during this time log period from <wvJobProgramPhase> table. <wvJobProgramPhase.DtTmStartActual> is the start of the phase, and if <wvJobProgramPhase.DttmEndActual> is not specified, then assume the phase lasts to the end of the time log period.

inactive.label: Inactive Time?
inactive.help: Inactive time, exclude from duration calculations for the reporting period and job.

problemcalc.label: Problem?
problemcalc.help: Displays 'yes' if a problem defined in the <wvjobintervalproblem> occurred during the time. If <wvjobintervalproblem.dttmend> is not specified, then assume the problem has not ended.

refnoproblemcalc.label: Problem Ref #
refnoproblemcalc.help: Reference numbers of the problems that occur during this time interval from <wvjobintervalproblem.refno>. If <wvjobintervalproblem.dttmend> is not specified, then assume the problem lasts to the end of the reporting period.

reportdaycalc.label: Job Day
reportdaycalc.help: Day number to which this record corresponds, since the start of the job. EQN: Sum of <wvjobreport.dttmstart> - <wvjob.dttmstart> + 1.

reportnocalc.label: Report Number
reportnocalc.help: Report number to which this record corresponds.

sumofdurationcalc.label: Cum Duration
sumofdurationcalc.help: Calculated cum of time log durations up to and including the current time log entry. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreporttimelog.duration> for all records up to and including the current one.

wvjobreportcostgen.label: One Time Cost
wvjobreportcostgen.help: Costs for the report period. Use the <wvJobReportCostGen.sysCarryFwdP> to carry costs to the next daily report.

costcumcalc.label: Cum Field Est
costcumcalc.help: EQN: Cum of <wvjobreportcostgen.cost> for this reporting period.

idrecafecustom.label: Custom AFE Allocation
idrecafecustom.help: Custom allocation of this cost to a specific AFE.

idrecintervalproblemcustom.label: Custom Interval Problem Allocation
idrecintervalproblemcustom.help: Custom allocation of this cost to a specific interval problem. If this field is left empty costs are allocated to phases assuming the costs are evenly distributed throughout the day.

idrecphasecustom.label: Custom Phase Allocation
idrecphasecustom.help: Custom allocation of this cost to a specific job phase. If this field is left empty costs are allocated to phases assuming the costs are evenly distributed throughout the day.

wvjobreportcostrental.label: Recurring Cost
wvjobreportcostrental.help: Choose costs defined in <wvJobRentalItem> to apply to this reporting period.

costcumcalc.label: Cum Field Est
costcumcalc.help: EQN: Cum of <wvjobreportcostrental.costrentalcalc> for this reporting period.

idrecafecustom.label: Custom AFE Allocation
idrecafecustom.help: Custom allocation of this cost to a specific AFE.

idrecintervalproblemcustom.label: Custom Interval Problem Allocation
idrecintervalproblemcustom.help: Custom allocation of this cost to a specific interval problem. If this field is left empty costs are allocated to phases assuming the costs are evenly distributed throughout the day.

idrecphasecustom.label: Custom Phase Allocation
idrecphasecustom.help: Custom allocation of this cost to a specific job phase. If this field is left empty costs are allocated to phases assuming the costs are evenly distributed throughout the day.

qty.label: Quantity
qty.help: Quantity of this item that were used during this report period.

useday.label: Day Charge?
useday.help: Check ON if daily charge is to apply in this report period.

usedepth.label: Depth Charged
usedepth.help: Depth interval that this item was used in this report period if charged by depth.

usehour.label: Hours Charged
usehour.help: Hours item was used in this report period if charged by the hour.

useother.label: Other Rate
useother.help: Other quantity that this item was used in this report period.

usestandby.label: Day Standby?
usestandby.help: Check ON if standby charge is to apply in this report period.

wvjobreportcontacts.label: Daily Contact
wvjobreportcontacts.help: Choose contacts for this day from the <wvJobContact> list. These are the primary contacts that will appear on the daily operations report.

idrecjobcontact.label: <capl>
idrecjobcontact.help: Primary daily contacts to appear on the daily operations report.

wvjobreportmudchk.label: Mud Check
wvjobreportmudchk.help: Mud or completion fluid checks that have occurred during the reporting period. Type, density, depth, temperature, etc.

alkalinity.label: Alkalinity
alkalinity.help: Measured alkalinity of whole mud sample.

barite.label: Barite
barite.help: Amount of barite present in the sample.

basefluidvoladded.label: Base Fluid Volume Added
basefluidvoladded.help: Volume of base fluid added to the active circulating system since the last report period

brine.label: Brine
brine.help: Proportion of the liquid fraction of an oil based mud which is composed of brine, calculated from the corrected oil/water ratio.

cacl.label: CaCl
cacl.help: Percent by weight of calcium chloride in the water phase of an oil based mud.

calcium.label: Calcium
calcium.help: Measured calcium ion concentration in the mud filtrate.

ceccuttings.label: CEC for Cuttings
ceccuttings.help: Cation exchange capacity (CEC) of drilled cuttings as measured by methylene blue titration.

chlorides.label: Chlorides
chlorides.help: Measured chloride ion concentration (salinity) in the mud filtrate for water based mud; chlorides content of whole mud sample for non aqueous fluids.

depth.label: Depth
depth.help: Well depth when mud check performed

dontuse.label: Don't Use
dontuse.help: Exclude this mud check from summary reporting.

dttm.label: Date
dttm.help: Report date and time.

ecd.label: ECD - Manual Entry
ecd.help: Manually entered ECD on this mud check. To be used where a third party application is used to determine the ECD of the system.

elecstability.label: Electric Stab
elecstability.help: Measured electrical stability of the sample, used to estimate emulsion strength of the oil based mud.

filtercake.label: Filter Cake
filtercake.help: Thickness of the residual solid film deposited on the filter paper by the loss of fluid from the filter press at 100psi pressure and surface temperature.

filtrate.label: Filtrate
filtrate.help: API filtrate (fluid loss) in 30 minutes using a filter press at 100 psi pressure and surface temperature.

funnelviscosity.label: Funnel Viscosity
funnelviscosity.help: Viscosity of the mud in terms of the time taken for a given volume to pass through a funnel.

gel10min.label: Gel 10 min
gel10min.help: Gel strength of the mud 10 minutes after stirring.

gel10sec.label: Gel 10 sec
gel10sec.help: Gel strength of the mud 10 seconds after stirring.

gel30min.label: Gel 30 min
gel30min.help: Gel strength of the mud 30 minutes after stirring.

hardnessca.label: Hardness Ca
hardnessca.help: Measured total hardness of the mud filtrate, reported as calcium.

hthpfiltercake.label: HTHP Filter Cake
hthpfiltercake.help: Thickness of residual solid film deposited on the filter paper by the loss of fluid from the HTHP filter press.

hthpfiltrate.label: HTHP Filtrate
hthpfiltrate.help: API HTHP fluid loss from the high temperature-high pressure filter press.

hthppres.label: HTHP Pressure
hthppres.help: Operating pressure of the high temperature-high pressure filter press. API specification is 500 psi.

hthptemp.label: HTHP Temperature
hthptemp.help: Operating temperature of the high temperature-high pressure filter press. API specification is 300 deg F.

kcalc.label: K
kcalc.help: Fluid consistency index (annulus). EQN=5.11*<wvJobReportMudChk.Vis100rpm>/(170.2^<wvJobReportMudChk.nCalc>) or <wvjobreportmudchk.koverride> if entered. Reference API Recommended Practice 13D. Note: additional conversion applied for US/metric.

koverride.label: K Override
koverride.help: Value of K, overrides the calculated value of K, Consistency Index

lcm.label: LCM
lcm.help: Description of lost circulation material in the sample

lime.label: Lime
lime.help: Calculated lime content of the oil based mud sample.

magnesium.label: Magnesium
magnesium.help: Measured magnesium ion concentration in the mud filtrate.

mbt.label: MBT
mbt.help: Cation exchange capacity (CEC) of the mud sample as measured by methylene blue titration.

mf.label: Mf
mf.help: Bromocresol green-methyl orange alkalinity of the filtrate measured by titration following the Pf reading.

mudadded.label: Whole Mud Added
mudadded.help: Whole mud volume added to system since the last report period

mudaddedcumcalc.label: Cum Mud Added
mudaddedcumcalc.help: Cumulative mud added up to and including this mud check report. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreportmudchk.mudadded>.

mudaddvoladded.label: Additive Volume Added
mudaddvoladded.help: Volume increase of active circulating system due to mud additives since the last report period

mudlosthole.label: Mud Lost to Hole
mudlosthole.help: Mud lost to the hole since the last report period.

mudlostholecumcalc.label: Cum Mud Lost to Hole
mudlostholecumcalc.help: Cumulative mud lost to hole as recorded in this and previous mud check reports. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreportmudchk.mudlosthole> up to and including the current mud check.

mudlostsurface.label: Mud Lost to Surface
mudlostsurface.help: Mud lost on surface since the last report period.

mudlostsurfacecumcalc.label: Cum Mud Lost to Surface
mudlostsurfacecumcalc.help: Cumulative mud lost on surface as recorded in this and previous mud check reports. EQN: Cum of <wvjobreportmudchk.mudlostsurface> up to and including the current mud check.

mudtyp.label: Type
mudtyp.help: Type of mud system in use at the time of the report. e.g. gel, polymer, oil base

mudvolactivecalc.label: Mud Vol Active Calc
mudvolactivecalc.help: (<wvJobReportMudChk.MudVolActive>+<wvJobReportMudChk.MudAdded>+<wvJobReportMudChk.MudAddVolAdded>+<wvJobReportMudChk.BaseFluidVolAdded>+<wvJobReportMudChk.MudDilutionRate>-<wvJobReportMudChk.MudLostHole>-<wvJobReportMudChk.MudLostSurface>)+ previous <wvJobReportMudChk.MudVolActiveCalc>. Apply this logic for the entire job. For example, if several days do not have mud checks, go back to the last mud check entered in the job and add to the equation.

mudvolactivesurfacecalc.label: Mud Vol Surface Active Calc
mudvolactivesurfacecalc.help: (<wvJobReportMudChk.MudVolActiveCalc> - sum (<wvJobReportMudChk.MudVolSurfActive>)). Apply this logic for the entire job. For example, if several days do not have mud checks, go back to the last mud check entered in the job and add to the equation.

mudvolsurfactive.label: Active Mud Volume (Surf)
mudvolsurfactive.help: Active surface mud volume at the end of the report period

ncalc.label: n
ncalc.help: Power Law constant (annulus). EQN =0.657 log(<wvjobreportmudchk.vis100rpm>/<wvjobreportmudchk.vis3rpm> ) or <wvjobreportmudchk.noverride> if entered. Reference API Recommended Practice 13D.

noverride.label: n Override
noverride.help: Value of n, overrides the calculated value of n

oiloncuttings.label: Oil on Cuttings
oiloncuttings.help: This can be measured or reported in 2 different ways, as a volume % or a weight %.

oilpercent.label: Percent Oil
oilpercent.help: Proportion of oil measured after passing the mud sample through a retort.

outofrangecalc.label: Out of Planned Range
outofrangecalc.help: Concatenation of all fields that are out of range from the planned mud check <wvJobProgramMud>.

p1.label: P1
p1.help: Phenolphthalein alkalinity of the filtrate to which sodium hydroxide and barium chloride have been added.

pf.label: Pf
pf.help: Phenolphthalein alkalinity of the filtrate, measured by titration with a standardized acid solution.

ph.label: pH
ph.help: Measured hydrogen ion concentration in the sample

plasticvis.label: PV Override
plasticvis.help: Manually entered plastic viscosity of the mud.

plasticviscalc.label: PV Calc
plasticviscalc.help: Plastic viscosity of the mud calculated from the 600 and 300 rpm viscometer readings. EQN: (<wvjobreportmudchk.vis600rpm> - <wvjobreportmudchk.vis300rpm>) or <wvjobreportmudchk.plasticvis> if it is entered.

pm.label: Pm
pm.help: Phenolphthalein alkalinity of the mud, measured by titration with a standardized acid solution.

pmfiltrate.label: Pm Filtrate
pmfiltrate.help: Phenolphthalein alkalinity of the mud filtrate, measured by titration with a standardized acid solution.

potassium.label: Potassium
potassium.help: Measured potassium ion concentration in the mud filtrate, measured by the STPB, sodium perchlorate or potassium select electrode method.

presbhstaticcalc.label: Bottom Hole Static Pressure
presbhstaticcalc.help: Calculated static bottom hole pressure due to hydrostatic weight of annular wellbore fluids. EQN: Pressure Gradient * <wvjobreportmudchk.tvdcalc>. Pressure gradient is <wvjobreportmudchk.density> * force of gravity/1000.

presvisc.label: Viscometer Pressure
presvisc.help: Pressure of the mud when the viscometer readings were made.

salt.label: Salt
salt.help: Salt % by weight of the brine phase for non aqueous fluids.

sands.label: Sand
sands.help: Proportion of sand-size particles in the mud sample, measured with a sand screen set.

solids.label: Solids
solids.help: Proportion of suspended and dissolved solids measured after passing the mud sample through a retort (mud still).

solidsavggrav.label: Average Gravity Solids
solidsavggrav.help: Average specific gravity of solids in mud.

solidscorrected.label: Corrected Solids
solidscorrected.help: Proportion of suspended corrected for dissolved solids (salt) content. Measurement for non aqueous fluids.

solidshighgrav.label: High Gravity Solids
solidshighgrav.help: Proportion of high gravity solids in the sample.

solidshighgravwt.label: High Gravity Solids by Weight
solidshighgravwt.help: Concentration of high gravity solids expressed as a weight concentration.

solidslowgrav.label: Low Gravity Solids
solidslowgrav.help: Proportion of low gravity solids in the sample.

solidslowgravwt.label: Low Gravity Solids by Weight
solidslowgravwt.help: Concentration of low gravity solids expressed as a weight concentration.

source.label: Source
source.help: Source of the mud sample. e.g. flow line, suction, etc.

tempph.label: Temp pH
tempph.help: Temperature of the sample when pH was measured.

tempvisc.label: Fan Temperature
tempvisc.help: Temperature of the mud when the viscometer readings were made.

tvdcalc.label: Depth (TVD)

fromlease.label: From lease

lefttorecover.label: Left to recover

nonrecov.label: Non-recoverable fluid
nonrecov.help: EQN: Sum of <wvjobreportfluidswelll.nonrecov> for the job.

tolease.label: To lease
tolease.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobReportFluidsLease.ToLease> for the job.

towell.label: To well

wvcas.help: Casing string information including run date, set depth. The individual component details are entered in <wvCasComp>. The tally tool can be used to enter details for individual joints.

centralizers.label: Centralizers

depthbtm.label: Set Depth

depthcutpull.label: Depth Cut Pull
depthcutpull.help: Depth the casing was cut and the upper portion of the string was pulled

depthtopcalc.label: Top Depth
depthtopcalc.help: Calculated top depth of the string. EQN: <wvcas.depthbtm> - cum <wvcas.lengthcalc>.

depthtvdbtmcalc.label: Set Depth (TVD)
depthtvdbtmcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvcas.depthbtm> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdcutpullcalc.label: Depth Cut Pull (TVD)

dttmcutpull.help: Date and time of cut and pull of upper portion of the casing string

dttmpull.label: Pull Date

dttmrun.label: Run Date

gradecalc.label: String Grade

idrecwellbore.label: <capl>
idrecwellbore.help: Wellbore that the bottom of the casing string is set in.

leakoffdensityfluidcalc.label: Leak Off Equivalent Fluid Density
leakoffdensityfluidcalc.help: Equivalent fluid density from the associated test. The leak off test must be associated with the casing string to in order to calculate. EQN: <wvtestleakoff.LeakOffDensityFluidCalc>.

leakoffprescalc.label: Leak Off Pressure
leakoffprescalc.help: Leak off test pressure. The leak off test must be associated with the casing string in order to calculate. EQN: <wvtestleakoff.LeakOffPresCalc>.

lengthcalc.label: Length
lengthcalc.help: Sum of all component lengths in the string. EQN: Cum of <wvcascomp.length>.

notecutpull.label: Cut Pull Note
notecutpull.help: Note describing the cut and pull

proposedpull.help: Is this string proposed to be pulled?

proposedrun.label: Proposed Run?
proposedrun.help: Is this string proposed to be run?

reasoncutpull.help: Reason for cut and partial pull

scratchers.label: Scratchers
scratchers.help: Summary of scratchers run on the string.

stickupkbcalc.label: Stick Up
stickupkbcalc.help: The length the string sticks up above the selected reference elevation. EQN: <wvcas.lengthcalc> - <wvcas.depthbtm>.

szdriftmincalc.label: String Min Drift
szdriftmincalc.help: Minimum drift of any component in the string. EQN: <wvcascomp.szdrift>.

szidnomcompmincalc.label: Min Nominal ID
szidnomcompmincalc.help: Minimum ID of any component in the string. EQN: <wvcascomp.szidnom>.

szidnommincalc.label: String Nominal ID
szidnommincalc.help: Nominal ID of the longest component in the string. EQN: <wvcascomp.szidnom>.

szodnomcompmaxcalc.label: Max Nominal OD
szodnomcompmaxcalc.help: Largest nominal OD of any component in the string. EQN: <wvcascomp.szodnom>.

szodnommaxcalc.label: String Nominal OD
szodnommaxcalc.help: Nominal OD of the longest component in the string. EQN: <wvcascomp.szodnom>.

totalstretchsumcalc.label: Total Stretch
totalstretchsumcalc.help: The total length of stretch calculated from stretch entered in component table. EQN: Sum of <wvCasComp.Length> where <wvCasComp.CompSubTyp>='Stretch Correction'

travelequipwt.label: Travelling Equipment Weight
travelequipwt.help: traveling equipment weight. Example: weight of blocks, crown, etc.

wtperlengthcalc.label: Weight/Length
wtperlengthcalc.help: Weight per length of the longest component in the string. EQN: <wvcascomp.wtperlength>.

wvcascomp.label: Casing Component
wvcascomp.help: Casing component details including OD, weight, grade. The tally tool can be used to enter details for individual joints.

conntgtperfbtm.label: Bottom Connection Target Performance
conntgtperfbtm.help: Target performance of the bottom connection.

conntgtperftop.label: Top Connection Target Performance
conntgtperftop.help: Target performance of the top connection.

depthbtmcalc.label: Bottom Depth
depthbtmcalc.help: Calculated bottom depth of component. EQN: <wvcas.depthbtm>-<wvcascomp.lengthcumcalc> of the previously run components.

depthtopcalc.help: Calculated top depth of component. EQN: <wvcascomp.depthbtmcalc> - <wvcascomp.length>.

depthtopcorrected.label: Corrected Top Depth
depthtopcorrected.help: Enter the true or corrected measured depth of the top of this component.

depthtvdbtmcalc.label: Bottom Depth (TVD)
depthtvdbtmcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvCasComp.DepthBtmCalc> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdtopcalc.label: Top Depth(TVD)
depthtvdtopcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvCasComp.DepthTopCalc> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

heatrating.help: Heat rating of this joint of casing. Alphanumeric rating.

iconname.help: Icon to display on the schematic.

inclbtmcalc.label: Bottom Inclination
inclbtmcalc.help: Bottom inclination for this component (linear interpolation).

inclmaxcalc.label: Max Inclination
inclmaxcalc.help: Max inclination for this component. Linear interpolation to determine inclination at top and bottom of component. These interpolated values are compared to all survey points between the top and bottom depths of the component, and the maximum is returned.

incltopcalc.label: Top Inclination
incltopcalc.help: Top inclination for this component (linear interpolation).

itemnocalc.label: Item Number
itemnocalc.help: This is a concatenated field. EQN: string number - component number.

jointstallycalc.help: Calculated number of joints from sum of run tallied joints in this component. EQN: Sum of all <wvcascomptally.jointrun> that are flagged.

lengthcumcalc.help: Cumulative length of string from bottom to top of component. EQN: Cum of <wvcascomp.length> for all components up to and including the current one.

lengthtallycalc.label: Tally Length
lengthtallycalc.help: Calculated tally length from sum of run tallied joints in this component. EQN: Cum of <wvcascomptally.length> for all records that have <wvcascomptally.jointrun> flagged.

usedclass.label: Class
usedclass.help: The used classification of the equipment

volumedispcalc.label: Volume Displaced (Open End)
volumedispcalc.help: The volume the string would displace if you allowed fluid to get inside the string. EQN=<wvCasComp.Length>*pi/4*((<wvCasComp.SzODNom>^2)-(<wvCasComp.SzIDNom>^2))

volumedispcumcalc.label: Cum Volume Displaced (Open End)
volumedispcumcalc.help: Cumulative volume of fluid displaced from bottom of string to top of component. EQN: Cum of <wvcascomp.volumedispcalc> from bottom of string up to and including the current component.

weightcalc.label: Weight
weightcalc.help: Weight (in air) of component. EQN: <wvcascomp.wtperlength> * <wvcascomp.length> * Force of Gravity.

weightcumcalc.label: Cum Weight
weightcumcalc.help: Cumulative weight (in air) of string including selected item. EQN: Cum of <wvcascomp.weightcalc> for all previous components up to and including the current component.

wvcascompecp.label: External Casing Packer

volumedispcumcalc.help: Cumulative volume of fluid displaced from bottom of string to top of component.

weightcumcalc.help: Cumulative weight (in air) of string including selected item.

runnocalc.help: Sequence number unique across all components. 1,2,3,…

cementtyp.help: Casing cement, squeeze or plug. The type is used to categorize the cement job, and also defines how the cement is drawn on the schematic.

dttmend.help: When cement job ends

dttmstart.label: Cementing Start Date
dttmstart.help: When cement job starts

idrecjob.help: Reference to the job during which this event was performed or is proposed to be performed

idrecstring.label: String
idrecstring.help: Link to string to be cemented.

objective.help: The goal of the cement job.

proposed.help: Is this a proposed cement job?

resulttechnical.label: Technical Result
resulttechnical.help: Result of cement job. Ex. Success, failure, more analysis required.

depthtvdtopcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvCementStage.DepthTop> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

dttmreleasedpres.help: Date and time that the pressure was released.

dttmtagged.help: The time that the cement was tagged

measmethod.help: How were the top and bottom levels measured?

proposeddrillout.help: Is this a proposed drill out of the cement plug?

vollost.help: Total lost volume for the stage

volreturncmnt.label: Cement Volume Return
volreturncmnt.help: Total cement return volume for the stage

weighttagged.label: Tag Weight
weighttagged.help: Amount of weight applied to top of cement while tagging

wvcementstagefluid.help: Each of the fluids that make up each stage, such as preflush, lead slurry, tail slurry, or displacement. The fluid additives are defined in the <wvCementStageFluidAdd>.

typ.label: Fluid Type

depthtopest.label: Estimated Top
depthtopest.help: Estimated depth of top of slurry

depthbtmest.label: Estimated Bottom Depth
depthbtmest.help: Estimated depth of bottom of slurry

depthtvdbtmestcalc.label: Est Bottom Depth (TVD)
depthtvdbtmestcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvCementStageFluid.DepthBtmEst> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

depthtvdtopestcalc.help: Interpolated TVD of the <wvCementStageFluid.DepthTopEst> in the associated wellbore, from the actual directional survey data.

dttmmix.label: Mixed Date
dttmmix.help: Date and time that this fluid/slurry was mixed.

dttmstartpump.label: Pump Start Date
dttmstartpump.help: Date and time that pumping began for this fluid/slurry.

dttmendpump.label: Pump End Date
dttmendpump.help: Date and time that pumping finished for this fluid/slurry.

mixwaterratio.label: Mix H20 Ratio
mixwaterratio.help: Volume of mix water used per sack of cement [volume/mass]

tempvisc.label: Fan Temperature
tempvisc.help: Temperature of the fluid when the viscometer readings were made.

comprstrtm2.label: Time of 2nd Compressive Strength Test
comprstrtm2.help: Time of second compressive strength test [time], default 24 hours

dttmend.help: Date of removal from well

wvwellheadcomp.label: Wellhead Component
wvwellheadcomp.help: Wellhead component details including top and bottom connections, etc.

dttmend.help: Date of removal from well

dttmstart.help: Date of installation on well

valvedttmorig.help: Original date component put into service.

wvtestleakoff.help: Leak off test details including pressure, density, and volume.

testtyp.help: Leak off test, formation integrity test, etc.

dttm.label: Test Date
dttm.help: Date and time of test.

leakoffpres.help: Pressure at surface when leak off occurred.

wvtestleakoffdata.label: LOT and FIT Test Data
wvtestleakoffdata.help: Test data details including time, pressure, and volume.

wvriser.label: Riser

depthtopcalc.help: Calculated top depth of the string. EQN: <wvriser.depthbtm>-<wvriser.lengthcalc>.

dttmpull.label: Pull Date

wtperlengthcalc.label: Weight/Length
wtperlengthcalc.help: Weight per length of the longest component in the string. EQN: <wvrisercomp.wtperlength>.

wvrisercomp.label: Riser Component

depthtopcalc.label: Top Depth
depthtopcalc.help: Calculated top depth of component. EQN: <wvrisercomp.depthbtmcalc> - <wvrisercomp.length>.

grade.label: Grade
grade.help: Grade of material in this section of the riser

iconname.label: Icon
iconname.help: Icon to display on the schematic.

itemnocalc.label: Item Number

wvworkingint.help: Working interest agreement with partner(s). Agreement type, start & end dates. The partner names and division of interest are detailed in <wvWorkingIntPartner>.

wvworkingintpartner.label: Partner
wvworkingintpartner.help: List of partners and their associated interest or royalty details.

interesttyp1.label: Interest Type
interesttyp1.help: Working Interest, Royalty Interest, ORRI, etc.

status.label: Status
status.help: Status of partner. Ex. penalty, non-penalty.

wvworkingintpartnercontact.label: Partner Contact
wvworkingintpartnercontact.help: Names, roles and contact information for personnel involved with the well.

title.label: Title
title.help: Job title or area of responsibility if title is not descriptive enough. ex.: Drilling Manager, Tool Push, Coring Operations Manager.

rptdist.label: Report Distribution
rptdist.help: Report distribution requirements for this contact

wvworkingintpartnerdataobl.label: Partner Data Obligation
wvworkingintpartnerdataobl.help: Partner data obligation and status, per agreement. Ex. daily reports, log data, end of well summary.

typ1.label: Data Type
typ1.help: Data Type. Ex. Logs, Daily Reports, etc.

typ2.label: Data Sub Type
typ2.help: Data Sub Type. Ex. Daily drilling report.

des.label: Description
des.help: Additional description of the data obligation.

status.label: Status
status.help: Status of data. Ex. Received, Pending, etc.

wvworkingintlink.label: Working Interest Link
wvworkingintlink.help: Link to <wvZone>(s), <wvJob>(s), <wvJobAFE>(s) that are relevant to this agreement.

idrecitem.label: Associated Items
idrecitem.help: Link to the associated Job, AFE, etc.

wvlegalstatus.label: Legal Status
wvlegalstatus.help: Legal status of the well. Type, start & end dates, status.

wvtimecurve.label: Real Time Curves
wvtimecurve.help: Imported time curve details. Ex. real time drilling data.

typ1.label: Type
typ1.help: Type of time curve. Ex. real time drilling.

typ2.label: Sub Type
typ2.help: Sub type of time curve. Ex. ROP

dttmstartref.label: Reference Start Date
dttmstartref.help: Start Date of time curve data. This is populated by the import.

dttmendref.label: Reference End Date
dttmendref.help: End Date of time curve data. This is populated by the import.

contractor.label: Company
contractor.help: Name of contractor that provided or captured the data.

analyst.label: Analyst
analyst.help: Name of person who analyzed the data.

idrecjob.label: <capl>
idrecjob.help: Associated Job

wvwellstatushistory.label: Well Status History
wvwellstatushistory.help: Well status history. This may be derived from <wvZoneStatus>, <wvWellboreStatus>, <wvPerforationStatus>. The status is not calculated, as the definition of overall well status differs between regions.

dttm.label: Date
dttm.help: Effective date of Well Status

source.label: Source
source.help: Source of information. Ex. government agency, etc.

wvexternaldata.label: External Data
wvexternaldata.help: Data created and maintained by other processes. This is a system table.

wvafecalc.label: AFE Summary
wvafecalc.help: Summary of AFE and associated costs for the well (across jobs). Excludes all <wvJobAFE.Exclude> records.

costafe.label: AFE Amount
costafe.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFECost.Amount> by Des, Code1, etc.

costafesup.label: AFE  Supplemental Amount
costafesup.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFECost.AmountSupp> by Des, Code1, etc.

costfieldest.label: Field Est
costfieldest.help: Total field estimate costs related to this AFE. EQN: Sum of <wvJobReportCostGen.Cost> + <wvJobReportCostRental.Cost> allocated to this AFE. For cost records that do not have <wvJobReportCostRental.IDRecAFECustom> or <wvJobReportCostGen.IDRecAFECustom> populated, allocate them across AFEs. For example: 2 AFEs, therefore 50% field cost to each AFE.

costfinalinvoice.label: Final Invoice
costfinalinvoice.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFEFinalInvoiceCost.Amount> by Des, Code1, etc.

wvafecostsumcalc.label: AFE Cost Breakdown Summary
wvafecostsumcalc.help: Cumulative costs by AFE for all Jobs in the well. Costs broken down by codes and description. AFE variance with Field Estimates and Final Invoiced costs. Excludes all <wvJobAFE.Exclude> records.

costafesup.label: AFE Supp Amount
costafesup.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFECost.AmountSupp> by Des, Code1, etc.

costfinalinvoice.label: Final Invoice
costfinalinvoice.help: EQN: Sum of <wvJobAFEFinalInvoiceCost.Amount> by Des, Code1, etc.
